workers who possess the requisite skills for the task
He credited her with a maturity she did not possess.
Isaak 's songwriting possesses a timeless quality.
Young adults possess incredible purchasing power.

senses.definition_vi: có một phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to have a powerful effect on somebody and control the way that they think, behave, etc.

examples.x: A terrible fear possessed her.
I was possessed by a desire to tell her everything.

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ đến ai đó và kiểm soát cách họ suy nghĩ, hành xử, v.v.

senses.definition: to make somebody do something that seems strange or unreasonable

examples.x: What possessed him to say such a thing?

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó làm điều gì đó có vẻ kỳ lạ hoặc vô lý

senses.definition: something that you own or have with you at a particular time

examples.x: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions.
One of Jane's most prized possessions was her photo album.
The ring is one of her most treasured possessions.
Please make sure you have all your possessions with you when leaving the plane.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ mà bạn sở hữu hoặc mang theo tại một thời điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: the state of having or owning something

examples.x: The possession of a passport is essential for foreign travel.
They had exclusive possession of the property as tenants.
On her father's death, she came into possession of (= received) a vast fortune.
You cannot legally take possession of the property (= start using it after buying it) until three weeks after the contract is signed.
The manuscript is just one of the treasures in their possession.
The gang was caught in possession of stolen goods.
drug possession
weapons/firearms possession

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng có hoặc sở hữu một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the state of having control of the ball

examples.x: to win/get/lose possession of the ball
The home team had most of the possession in the first half.
The team was struggling to retain possession of the ball.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng kiểm soát bóng

senses.definition: the state of having illegal drugs or weapons with you at a particular time

examples.x: She was charged with possession.
They were charged with unlawful possession of firearms.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng có ma túy hoặc vũ khí bất hợp pháp bên mình tại một thời điểm nhất định

senses.definition: a country that is controlled or governed by another country

examples.x: The former colonial possessions are now independent states.
the country's overseas possessions

senses.definition_vi: một quốc gia bị kiểm soát hoặc cai trị bởi một quốc gia khác

senses.definition: the situation when somebody’s mind is believed to be controlled by the Devil or by an evil spirit
senses.definition_vi: tình huống khi tâm trí ai đó được cho là bị Quỷ hoặc một linh hồn tà ác kiểm soát

senses.definition: if you already have or control something, it is difficult for somebody else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn đã có hoặc kiểm soát một cái gì đó, rất khó để người khác lấy nó đi khỏi bạn, ngay cả khi họ có quyền hợp pháp đối với nó

senses.definition: a thing that may happen or be true; the fact that something might happen or be true, but is not certain

examples.x: Bankruptcy is a real possibility if sales don't improve.
What had seemed impossible now seemed a distinct possibility.
Reaching the final seems a remote possibility.
There's a strong possibility that it will rain.
There is now no possibility that she will make a full recovery.
We cannot exclude the possibility that another person may have been involved.
I have considered the possibility that she is dead.
He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
There is a real possibility of war.
The company has raised the possibility of legal action.
I am excited about the possibility of going to the Olympics.
This is a one-year appointment, with the possibility of renewal for an additional year.

senses.definition_vi: một điều có thể xảy ra hoặc đúng; sự thật rằng một điều gì đó có thể xảy ra hoặc đúng, nhưng không chắc chắn

senses.definition: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation

examples.x: The possibilities are endless.
Selling the house is just one possibility that is open to us.
We have to investigate every possibility.
Police are considering a wide range of possibilities.
to exhaust all the possibilities
She explored the possibility of studying in the US.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những điều khác nhau bạn có thể làm trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: something that gives you a chance to achieve something

examples.x: There are countless possibilities for future research.
The course offers a range of exciting possibilities for developing your skills.
In a bookshop, the possibilities for browsing are endless.
Career possibilities for women are much greater than they were fifty years ago.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó mang lại cho bạn cơ hội để đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: if something has possibilities, it can be improved or made successful

examples.x: The house is in a bad state of repair but it has possibilities.
He was the first to see the possibilities of the plan.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cái gì đó có tiềm năng, nó có thể được cải thiện hoặc trở nên thành công

senses.definition: possible/not possible

examples.x: A successful outcome is not beyond the realms of possibility.
It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.

senses.definition_vi: có thể/không thể

senses.definition: that can be done or achieved

examples.x: New technology has made it possible to communicate more easily.

examples.cf: it is possible to do something
examples.x: It is possible to get there by bus.
It's just not physically possible to finish all this by the end of the week.

examples.cf: it is possible for somebody to do something
examples.x: Would it be possible for me to leave a message for her?
This wouldn't have been possible without you.
I'd like the money back by next week if possible.
Try to avoid losing your temper if at all possible (= if you can).
Use public transport whenever possible (= when you can).
The doctors did all that was humanly possible to save him.
We spent every possible moment on the beach.
Expansion was made possible by the investment of government money.
This film was better than I thought possible.

senses.definition_vi: có thể được thực hiện hoặc đạt được

senses.definition: that might exist or happen but is not certain to

examples.x: the possible side effects of the drug
a possible future president
Frost is possible, although unlikely, at this time of year.
It is quite possible that the river will flood again.
It's just possible that I gave them the wrong directions.
‘You might be wrong, of course!’ ‘It’s possible, but I doubt it.’
With the possible exception of the Beatles, no other band has become so successful so quickly.
‘Do you think he’ll resign?’ ‘Anything’s possible where he’s concerned.’
a possible outcome/effect/consequence
We have to look at every possible scenario.

senses.definition_vi: có thể tồn tại hoặc xảy ra nhưng không chắc chắn

senses.definition: reasonable or acceptable in a particular situation

examples.x: There are several possible explanations.
Please suggest possible ways in which you would improve the existing program.
a possible solution
One possible cause/reason is…

senses.definition_vi: hợp lý hoặc chấp nhận được trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: used after adjectives to emphasize that something is the best, worst, etc. of its type

examples.x: It was the best possible surprise anyone could have given me.
Don't leave your packing until the last possible moment.
Jacobs faces the maximum possible sentence of five years imprisonment.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau tính từ để nhấn mạnh rằng một cái gì đó là tốt nhất, tệ nhất, v.v. trong loại của nó

senses.definition: as quickly, much, soon, etc. as you can

examples.x: We will get your order to you as soon as possible.
Try to give as much detail as possible in your answer.
She did as much as possible to help him.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh nhất, nhiều nhất, sớm nhất, v.v. có thể

senses.definition: a situation in which you have all the possible advantages/disadvantages together

examples.x: In the best of all possible worlds, you should be able to develop your career and enjoy a rewarding family life.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn có tất cả những lợi thế/bất lợi có thể có cùng nhau

senses.definition: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time

examples.x: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
Maybe in the best of all possible worlds things would be different.

senses.definition_vi: những lợi ích của hai hoặc nhiều tình huống hoàn toàn khác nhau mà bạn có thể tận hưởng cùng một lúc

senses.definition: a situation in which you have all the possible disadvantages at the same time
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà bạn có tất cả những bất lợi có thể có cùng một lúc

senses.definition: used to say that something might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain

examples.x: It was possibly their worst performance ever.
She found it difficult to get on with her, possibly because of the difference in their ages.
‘Will you be around next week?’ ‘Possibly.’
‘I’m sure he didn’t mean to be rude.’ ‘Quite possibly (= you may be right), but the damage has been done.’
Last year, his mother died, possibly due to heart failure.
a popular but possibly dangerous type of extreme diet

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một cái gì đó có thể tồn tại, xảy ra hoặc đúng, nhưng bạn không chắc chắn

senses.definition: used with can/could to emphasize that you are surprised, annoyed, etc. about something

examples.x: You can't possibly mean that!
How could you possibly think that I had anything to do with it!
He turned out to be the nicest guy you could possibly imagine.
What could possibly go wrong?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với can/could để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn ngạc nhiên, khó chịu, v.v. về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: used with could to ask somebody politely to do something

examples.x: Could you possibly open that window?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với could để lịch sự yêu cầu ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used with can/could to say that somebody will do or has done as much as they can in order to make something happen

examples.x: I will come as soon as I possibly can.
They tried everything they possibly could to improve the situation.
We don’t want these rumours to spread if we can possibly avoid it.
I don't see what more he could possibly do.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với can/could để nói rằng ai đó sẽ làm hoặc đã làm hết sức có thể để làm cho điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: used with negatives, especially can't/couldn't, to say strongly that you cannot do something or that something cannot or could not happen or be done

examples.x: I can't possibly tell you that!
You can't possibly carry all those bags.
‘Let me buy it for you.’ ‘That's very kind of you, but I couldn't possibly (= accept).’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với phủ định, đặc biệt là can't/couldn't, để nói mạnh mẽ rằng bạn không thể làm điều gì đó hoặc điều gì đó không thể hoặc không thể xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.

examples.x: I'll send the original to you by post.
I sent it by first-class post.
I'll put the documents in the post to you tomorrow.
My application got lost in the post.

senses.definition_vi: hệ thống chính thức được sử dụng để gửi và giao thư, bưu kiện, v.v.

senses.definition: letters, packages, etc. that are sent and delivered

examples.x: There was a lot of post this morning.
Have you opened your post yet?

senses.definition_vi: thư, bưu kiện, v.v. được gửi và giao

senses.definition: an occasion during the day when letters, etc. are collected or delivered

examples.x: to catch/miss the post
The parcel came in this morning's post.
The form should arrive in the post tomorrow.
Payment should be sent by return of post (= immediately).
Do you get a second post here?

senses.definition_vi: một lần trong ngày thư, v.v. được thu gom hoặc giao

senses.definition: a message sent to a discussion group on the internet; a piece of writing that forms part of a blog

examples.x: I love reading her posts because I learn so much.
They have deleted all my posts.
She wrote a post about the experience on her blog.
This post by Mark Brady is very interesting.
The forum does not allow posts from non-members.

senses.definition_vi: một tin nhắn được gửi đến một nhóm thảo luận trên internet; một đoạn văn bản tạo thành một phần của blog

senses.definition: a job, especially an important one in a large organization

examples.x: an academic/a government post
She took up a teaching post at Basle University.
to resign (from)/quit/leave a post
We will be creating 15 new posts next year.
The company has been unable to fill the post.
He has held the post for three years.
She was offered a key post in the new government.
He accepted the post of deputy prime minister.

senses.definition_vi: một công việc, đặc biệt là một công việc quan trọng trong một tổ chức lớn

senses.definition: an act of sending somebody to a particular place to do their job, especially for a limited period of time

examples.x: an overseas post
The island is rated by diplomats as a hardship post (= one that people do not like to be sent to because it is not a very comfortable place to live).

senses.definition_vi: một hành động gửi ai đó đến một địa điểm cụ thể để làm công việc của họ, đặc biệt là trong một khoảng thời gian giới hạn

senses.definition: the place where somebody, especially a soldier, does their job

examples.x: a police/military/customs post
an observation post
Three soldiers were shot dead at a border post.
The guards were ordered not to leave their posts.

senses.definition_vi: nơi ai đó, đặc biệt là một người lính, làm công việc của họ

senses.definition: a piece of wood or metal that is set in the ground in a position pointing upwards, especially to support something or to mark a point

examples.x: She tied the dog to a post.
corner posts (= that mark the corners of a sports field)
The team’s ‘net’ was a piece of string tied to two posts.

senses.definition_vi: một miếng gỗ hoặc kim loại được cắm xuống đất ở một vị trí hướng lên trên, đặc biệt là để đỡ một cái gì đó hoặc để đánh dấu một điểm

senses.definition: the place where a race finishes, especially in horse racing

examples.x: The first horse past the post wins the race.
She led for most of the way before being pipped at the post (= beaten at the last moment).

senses.definition_vi: nơi cuộc đua kết thúc, đặc biệt là trong đua ngựa

senses.definition: one of the two posts that form part of a goal

examples.x: The ball hit the post and bounced in.
He steered a shot between the goalkeeper and the near post.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai cột tạo thành một phần của khung thành

senses.definition: to be forced to go from one person or situation to another without achieving anything

examples.x: Morale is very low. People have just had enough of being thrown from pillar to post.

senses.definition_vi: bị buộc phải di chuyển từ người này hoặc tình huống này sang người khác hoặc tình huống khác mà không đạt được bất cứ điều gì

senses.definition: very deaf (= unable to hear anything)
senses.definition_vi: rất điếc (= không thể nghe thấy gì)

senses.definition: to send a letter, etc. to somebody by post

examples.x: The cost of posting a letter has gone up again.
Have you posted off your order yet?
Is it OK if I post the documents to you next week?
Is it OK if I post you the documents next week?

senses.definition_vi: gửi thư, v.v. cho ai đó qua đường bưu điện

senses.definition: to put a letter, etc. into a postbox

examples.x: Could you post this letter for me?

senses.definition_vi: bỏ thư, v.v. vào hộp thư

senses.definition: to put something through a hole into a container

examples.x: Let yourself out and post the keys through the letter box.

senses.definition_vi: cho một cái gì đó qua một lỗ vào một thùng chứa

senses.definition: to put information or pictures on a website

examples.x: More details will be posted on the website tomorrow.
Many thanks to all who have posted comments.
I'll post some pictures when I get back.
to post a video/photo/message/link
The photos have been provided by fans who post on the message board.
I’ve been posting now and again at ‘British Moneymaker’.

senses.definition_vi: đăng thông tin hoặc hình ảnh lên một trang web

senses.definition: to announce something publicly or officially, especially financial information or a warning

examples.x: The company posted a $1.1 billion loss.
A snow warning was posted for Ohio.
The aircraft and its crew were posted missing.

senses.definition_vi: thông báo điều gì đó một cách công khai hoặc chính thức, đặc biệt là thông tin tài chính hoặc cảnh báo

senses.definition: to send somebody to a place for a period of time as part of their job

examples.x: She's been posted to Washington for two years.
Most of our employees get posted abroad at some stage.
Balden was later posted to Luqa as station commander.

senses.definition_vi: gửi ai đó đến một địa điểm trong một khoảng thời gian như một phần công việc của họ

senses.definition: to put somebody, especially a soldier, in a particular place so that they can guard a building or area

examples.x: Guards have been posted along the border.
A police officer was posted outside the door to make sure the suspect didn’t leave the building.

senses.definition_vi: đặt ai đó, đặc biệt là một người lính, vào một vị trí cụ thể để họ có thể canh gác một tòa nhà hoặc khu vực

senses.definition: to put a notice, etc. in a public place so that people can see it

examples.x: A copy of the letter was posted on the noticeboard.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một thông báo, v.v. ở một nơi công cộng để mọi người có thể nhìn thấy nó

senses.definition: to pay money to a court so that a person accused of a crime can go free until their trial

examples.x: She was released after posting $100 cash bond and her driver's license.

senses.definition_vi: nộp tiền cho tòa án để một người bị buộc tội có thể được tự do cho đến phiên tòa của họ

senses.definition: to regularly give somebody the most recent information about something and how it is developing

examples.x: I’ll keep you posted on his progress.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên cung cấp cho ai đó thông tin mới nhất về điều gì đó và cách nó đang phát triển

senses.definition: a large notice, often with a picture on it, that is put in a public place to advertise something

examples.x: campaign/election posters
a poster campaign (= an attempt to educate people about something by using posters)
a wanted poster (= with a picture of a person that the police are looking for)
They put up a poster advertising the concert.

senses.definition_vi: một thông báo lớn, thường có hình ảnh, được đặt ở nơi công cộng để quảng cáo thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a large picture that is printed on paper and put on a wall as decoration

examples.x: posters of her favourite bands
a film/movie poster

senses.definition_vi: một bức tranh lớn, được in trên giấy và dán trên tường để trang trí

senses.definition: a person who posts a message on a message board (= a place on a website where people can read or write messages)
senses.definition_vi: một người đăng một tin nhắn trên bảng tin (= một nơi trên trang web nơi mọi người có thể đọc hoặc viết tin nhắn)

senses.definition: to arrange for an event, etc. to take place at a later time or date than originally planned

examples.x: The game has already been postponed three times.
We'll have to postpone the meeting until next week.
They have agreed to postpone repayment of the loan to a future unspecified date.
It was an unpopular decision to postpone building the new hospital.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp để một sự kiện, v.v. diễn ra vào một thời điểm hoặc ngày sau đó so với kế hoạch ban đầu

senses.definition: a deep round container used for cooking things in

examples.x: pots and pans
You'll need a large cooking pot with a tight-fitting lid.

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa tròn sâu dùng để nấu ăn

senses.definition: a container made of glass, clay or plastic, used for storing food in

examples.x: a pot of jam
a yoghurt pot

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa bằng thủy tinh, đất sét hoặc nhựa, dùng để bảo quản thực phẩm

senses.definition: a container of various kinds, made for a particular purpose

examples.x: a coffee pot
a pencil pot
Is there any more tea in the pot?

senses.definition_vi: một vật chứa nhiều loại, được làm cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: the amount contained in a pot

examples.x: They drank a pot of coffee.
I had such a craving for marmalade when I was pregnant that I ate a whole pot in one day.

senses.definition_vi: lượng chứa trong một cái nồi

senses.definition: a bowl, etc. that is made by a potter

examples.x: The newly made pots are glazed when they are completely dry.

senses.definition_vi: một cái bát, v.v. được làm bởi một thợ gốm

senses.definition: the total amount of money that is bet in a card game
senses.definition_vi: tổng số tiền được đặt cược trong một trò chơi bài

senses.definition: all the money given by a group of people in order to do something together, for example to buy food, or available for a particular purpose
senses.definition_vi: tổng số tiền được đóng góp bởi một nhóm người để làm điều gì đó cùng nhau, ví dụ để mua thức ăn, hoặc có sẵn cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: cannabis (= a drug (illegal in many countries) made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which gives the person smoking it a feeling of being relaxed)

examples.x: pot smoking

senses.definition_vi: cần sa (= một loại thuốc (bất hợp pháp ở nhiều quốc gia) được làm từ lá và hoa khô của cây gai dầu, mang lại cho người hút cảm giác thư giãn)

senses.definition: a shot that somebody fires without aiming carefully

examples.x: He took a pot at the neighbour's cat with his air rifle.

senses.definition_vi: một phát bắn mà ai đó bắn mà không nhắm cẩn thận

senses.definition: the act of hitting a ball into one of the pockets around the edge of the table
senses.definition_vi: hành động đánh một quả bóng vào một trong những lỗ xung quanh mép bàn

senses.definition: a pot belly (= a large stomach that sticks out)
senses.definition_vi: bụng bia (= một cái bụng lớn nhô ra)

senses.definition: a large prize or reward that somebody hopes for but is unlikely to get
senses.definition_vi: một giải thưởng hoặc phần thưởng lớn mà ai đó hy vọng nhưng khó có thể đạt được

senses.definition: to become much less good because people are not working hard or taking care of things

examples.x: I've lived here for years but the place has gone to pot recently

senses.definition_vi: trở nên kém đi nhiều vì mọi người không làm việc chăm chỉ hoặc chăm sóc mọi thứ

senses.definition: likely to change; in the process of changing
senses.definition_vi: có khả năng thay đổi; đang trong quá trình thay đổi

senses.definition: used to say that you should not criticize somebody for a fault that you have yourself
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn không nên chỉ trích ai đó vì một lỗi mà bạn cũng mắc phải

senses.definition: when you take pot luck, you choose something or go somewhere without knowing very much about it, but hope that it will be good, pleasant, etc.

examples.x: It's pot luck whether you get good advice or not.
You're welcome to stay to supper, but you'll have to take pot luck (= eat whatever is available).

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn chọn đại, bạn chọn một thứ gì đó hoặc đi đến một nơi nào đó mà không biết nhiều về nó, nhưng hy vọng rằng nó sẽ tốt, dễ chịu, v.v.

senses.definition: a very large amount of money
senses.definition_vi: một số tiền rất lớn

senses.definition: to put something into a space that is too small for it

examples.x: Writing a history of the world in a single volume is like putting a quart into a pint pot.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một cái gì đó vào một không gian quá nhỏ cho nó

senses.definition: used to say that when you are impatient for something to happen, time seems to pass very slowly
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng khi bạn thiếu kiên nhẫn chờ đợi điều gì đó xảy ra, thời gian dường như trôi qua rất chậm

senses.definition: a round white vegetable with a brown or red skin that grows underground as part of a plant also called a potato

examples.x: Will you peel the potatoes for me?
roast/fried potatoes
potato salad
leek and potato soup

senses.definition_vi: một loại rau củ màu trắng tròn có vỏ màu nâu hoặc đỏ mọc dưới lòng đất như một phần của cây cũng gọi là khoai tây

senses.definition: that can develop into something or be developed in the future

examples.x: potential customers/buyers/investors/clients
We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.
the potential benefits of European integration
potential risks
a potential threat
the potential impact of the latest surge in oil prices
First we need to identify actual and potential problems.
Have you looked into the potential side effects of the treatment?
a potential prime minister
a potential source of conflict

senses.definition_vi: có thể phát triển thành thứ gì đó hoặc được phát triển trong tương lai

senses.definition: the possibility of something happening or being developed or used

examples.x: the potential for change
The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.
the huge potential of the American market
The disease has the potential to cause a global health emergency.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc được phát triển hoặc sử dụng

senses.definition: qualities that exist and can be developed

examples.x: All children should be encouraged to realize their full potential.
to reach/fulfil/achieve your potential
an artist of great potential
John shows great potential in the swimming pool.
She has great potential as an artist.
her belief in art's potential as a healing agent
He has the potential to become a world-class musician.
We're looking for a trainee with potential.
The house has a lot of potential.
Zambia has large unexploited tourism potential.

senses.definition_vi: những phẩm chất tồn tại và có thể được phát triển

senses.definition: the difference in voltage between two points in an electric field or circuit
senses.definition_vi: sự chênh lệch điện áp giữa hai điểm trong điện trường hoặc mạch điện

senses.definition: used to say that something may develop into something

examples.x: a potentially dangerous situation

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó có thể phát triển thành điều gì đó

senses.definition: the unit of money in the UK, worth 100 pence

examples.x: a ten-pound note
a pound coin
I've spent £25 on food today.
What would you do if you won a million pounds?
Total losses were estimated at over three million pounds.
The blaze caused thousands of pounds worth of damage.
He built the business into a multimillion-pound food empire.

senses.definition_vi: đơn vị tiền tệ ở Vương quốc Anh, trị giá 100 xu

senses.definition: the unit of money of several other countries

examples.x: His salary will be about 5  000 Egyptian pounds per month.

senses.definition_vi: đơn vị tiền tệ của một số quốc gia khác

senses.definition: the value of the British pound compared with the value of the money of other countries

examples.x: the strength/weakness of the pound against other currencies
The pound fell sharply to a record low against the yen.
The pound closed (= finished the day's trading) slightly down at $1.534.
a run on the pound (= when many people sell pounds and the value of the pound falls)

senses.definition_vi: giá trị của bảng Anh so với giá trị tiền tệ của các quốc gia khác

senses.definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 0.454 of a kilogram

examples.x: half a pound of butter
They cost two dollars a pound.
I've lost six and a half pounds since I started my diet.
a bronze sculpture weighing 7,000 pounds
They sell organic black soya beans in 25-pound bags.
The couch potato lifestyle is causing many people to pile on the pounds (= gain weight).
She has shed 30 pounds.

senses.definition_vi: đơn vị đo trọng lượng, bằng 0,454 kg

senses.definition: a place where vehicles that have been parked illegally are kept until their owners pay to get them back
senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà các phương tiện bị đỗ trái phép được giữ cho đến khi chủ sở hữu trả tiền để lấy lại chúng

senses.definition: a place where dogs that have been found in the street without their owners are kept until their owners claim them
senses.definition_vi: một nơi để giữ chó bị bỏ rơi trên đường phố cho đến khi chủ của chúng nhận lại.

senses.definition: used to say that since you have started to do something, it is worth spending as much time or money as you need to in order to complete it
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng vì bạn đã bắt đầu làm điều gì đó, nên bạn cần dành đủ thời gian hoặc tiền bạc cần thiết để hoàn thành nó.

senses.definition: it is better to stop something bad from happening rather than try to deal with the problems after it has happened
senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn là ngăn chặn điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra thay vì cố gắng giải quyết các vấn đề sau khi nó đã xảy ra.

senses.definition: the full amount that somebody owes you, even if this will cause them trouble or difficulty

examples.x: You’re determined to have your pound of flesh, aren’t you?

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ số tiền mà ai đó nợ bạn, ngay cả khi điều này sẽ gây ra rắc rối hoặc khó khăn cho họ.

senses.definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle

examples.x: Pour the sauce over the pasta.
She poured boiling water down the sink.
Pour away as much fat as possible from the roasting pan.
Although I poured it carefully, I still managed to spill some.
The crew mixed and poured the concrete.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho chất lỏng hoặc chất khác chảy ra khỏi vật chứa theo một dòng liên tục, đặc biệt bằng cách nghiêng vật chứa.

senses.definition: to serve a drink by letting it flow from a container into a cup or glass

examples.x: Will you pour the coffee?
a freshly poured soda
I've poured you a cup of tea.
I've poured a cup of tea for you.
I was in the kitchen, pouring out drinks.
Shall I pour?

senses.definition_vi: phục vụ đồ uống bằng cách cho nó chảy từ vật chứa vào cốc hoặc ly.

senses.definition: when rain pours down or when it’s pouring (with) rain, rain is falling heavily

examples.x: It's pouring outside.
The rain continued to pour down.
It's pouring with rain.
It's pouring rain outside.

senses.definition_vi: khi mưa đổ xuống hoặc khi trời đang mưa (với) mưa, mưa rơi nặng hạt.

senses.definition: to flow quickly in a continuous stream

examples.x: Tears poured down his cheeks.
Thick black smoke was pouring out of the roof.
Blood was pouring from the wound.
The sweat was pouring off her.
Light poured in.
A torrent of words poured from her mouth.

senses.definition_vi: chảy nhanh thành dòng liên tục.

senses.definition: to come or go somewhere continuously in large numbers

examples.x: The crowd poured into the streets.
Commuters came pouring out of the station.
Congratulatory messages poured in on social media for the new parents.

senses.definition_vi: đến hoặc đi đến một nơi nào đó liên tục với số lượng lớn.

senses.definition: used to say that when one bad thing happens to you, other bad things happen soon after
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng khi một điều tồi tệ xảy ra với bạn, những điều tồi tệ khác sẽ xảy ra ngay sau đó.

senses.definition: to give reasons for not being in favour of something; to criticize something

examples.x: She immediately poured cold water on his plans to expand the business.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra lý do để không ủng hộ điều gì đó; chỉ trích điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to try to settle an argument
senses.definition_vi: cố gắng giải quyết một cuộc tranh cãi.

senses.definition: to tell somebody all your problems, feelings, etc.

examples.x: Finally, he broke down in tears and poured out his heart to her.

senses.definition_vi: kể cho ai đó nghe tất cả các vấn đề, cảm xúc, v.v. của bạn.

senses.definition: to speak about somebody/something in a way that shows that you do not respect them or have a good opinion of them

examples.x: Opposition politicians poured scorn on the proposals.

senses.definition_vi: nói về ai đó/điều gì đó theo cách thể hiện sự thiếu tôn trọng hoặc không có ý kiến tốt về họ.

senses.definition: the state of being poor

examples.x: conditions of extreme/abject poverty
to alleviate poverty
Many elderly people live in poverty.
For him music was the way out of poverty.
She was born into poverty and political chaos.
More than 1.5 million Americans fell into poverty last year.
The government is aiming to reduce child poverty (= the number of children living below the poverty line).
to tackle/combat/fight poverty
to escape/flee poverty

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng nghèo khó.

senses.definition: a lack of something; poor quality

examples.x: There is a poverty of colour in her work.
His work displays a poverty of imagination.

senses.definition_vi: sự thiếu hụt một cái gì đó; chất lượng kém.

senses.definition: a dry mass of very small fine pieces or grains

examples.x: chilli/cocoa powder
lumps of chalk crushed to a fine white powder
The snow was like powder.
a wide range of cleaning fluids and powders
The mustard is sold in powder form.
powder skiing (= on fine dry snow)

senses.definition_vi: một khối khô gồm các hạt hoặc mảnh rất nhỏ, mịn.

senses.definition: a very fine, soft, dry substance that you can put on your face to make it look smooth and dry

examples.x: I only use lipstick and a little powder.
She quickly dabbed some powder on her cheeks.

senses.definition_vi: một chất khô, mịn, mềm mà bạn có thể thoa lên mặt để làm cho da trông mịn màng và khô ráo.

senses.definition: explosive powder used especially in bombs or fireworks
senses.definition_vi: chất nổ được sử dụng đặc biệt trong bom hoặc pháo hoa.

senses.definition: to remain ready for a possible emergency
senses.definition_vi: giữ cho bản thân sẵn sàng cho một tình huống khẩn cấp có thể xảy ra.

senses.definition: to leave suddenly; to run away
senses.definition_vi: rời đi đột ngột; bỏ chạy.

senses.definition: the ability to control people or things

examples.x: He has the power to make things very unpleasant for us.
Religion is losing its power to shape our behaviour.
The aim is to give people more power over their own lives.
The government wields enormous power over the economy.
She had him completely in her power (= was able to do what she liked with him).
In those days the king exercised real political power.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng kiểm soát người khác hoặc sự vật.

senses.definition: political control of a country or an area

examples.x: Hitler seized power in Germany in 1933.
The following year he took power in a military coup.
Labour won two elections in 1974, but lost power in 1979.
The present regime has been in power for two years.
The party came to power at the last election.
They are hoping to return to power.
a power struggle between rival factions within the party

senses.definition_vi: quyền kiểm soát chính trị của một quốc gia hoặc một khu vực.

senses.definition: energy that can be collected and used to operate a machine, to make electricity, etc.

examples.x: nuclear/wind/solar power
engine power
wave power
They used these streams to generate power for the mill.
Solar power generation is greatly affected by cloud cover.

senses.definition_vi: năng lượng có thể được thu thập và sử dụng để vận hành máy móc, tạo ra điện, v.v.

senses.definition: the public supply of electricity

examples.x: They've switched off the power.

the national power grid
a power failure

senses.definition_vi: nguồn cung cấp điện công cộng.

senses.definition: the quality of having great power or force, or of being very effective

examples.x: The ship was helpless against the power of the storm.

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng có sức mạnh hoặc lực lớn, hoặc có hiệu quả cao.

senses.definition: physical strength used in action; physical strength that somebody possesses and might use

examples.x: She hit the ball with as much power as she could.

senses.definition_vi: sức mạnh thể chất được sử dụng trong hành động; sức mạnh thể chất mà ai đó sở hữu và có thể sử dụng.

senses.definition: the ability or opportunity to do something

examples.x: I will do everything in my power to help you.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng hoặc cơ hội để làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: a particular ability of the body or mind

senses.definition_vi: một khả năng cụ thể của cơ thể hoặc tâm trí.

senses.definition: all the abilities of a person’s body or mind

examples.x: At 26, he is at the height of his powers and ranked fourth in the world.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả các khả năng của cơ thể hoặc tâm trí một người.

examples.x: The powers of the police must be clearly defined.

The Secretary of State has the power to approve the proposals.
The president has the power of veto over all new legislation.
Police in riot gear used their powers under the Public Order Act to move on 300 protesters.

senses.definition_vi: quyền hoặc thẩm quyền của một người hoặc nhóm để làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: a country with a lot of influence in world affairs, or with great military strength

examples.x: He transformed a backward country into a world power.
major European powers such as France and Germany
Türkiye is growing as an economic power.

senses.definition_vi: một quốc gia có nhiều ảnh hưởng trong các vấn đề thế giới, hoặc có sức mạnh quân sự lớn.

senses.definition: strength or influence in a particular area of activity

examples.x: These companies have enormous economic power.
the exercise of military power
air/sea power (= military strength in the air/at sea)

Several years ago, computer processing power was considerably less than it is now.
The country's dominance was assured by its technological and military power.

senses.definition_vi: sức mạnh hoặc ảnh hưởng trong một lĩnh vực hoạt động cụ thể.

senses.definition: the influence of a particular thing or group within society

examples.x: Hollywood star power

the power of the media

senses.definition_vi: sức ảnh hưởng của một thứ hoặc một nhóm cụ thể trong xã hội.

senses.definition_vi: số lần mà một lượng được nhân với chính nó.

examples.x: the power of a microscope/telescope

senses.definition_vi: mức độ mà một thấu kính có thể làm cho vật thể trông lớn hơn.

senses.definition: a good or evil spirit that controls the lives of others

examples.x: the powers of darkness (= the forces of evil)

belief in a higher power

senses.definition_vi: một linh hồn tốt hoặc xấu kiểm soát cuộc sống của người khác.

senses.definition: the higher levels of government, where important decisions are made

examples.x: She had considerable influence in the corridors of power.

senses.definition_vi: các cấp cao hơn của chính phủ, nơi các quyết định quan trọng được đưa ra.

senses.definition: to be very good for somebody’s physical or mental health

examples.x: A break would do us all a power of good.

senses.definition_vi: rất tốt cho sức khỏe thể chất hoặc tinh thần của ai đó.

senses.definition: used to encourage somebody or express support for their actions
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để khuyến khích ai đó hoặc bày tỏ sự ủng hộ đối với hành động của họ.

senses.definition: the person who really controls an organization, a country, etc. in contrast to the person who is legally in charge

examples.x: His assistant was thought to be the real power behind the throne.

senses.definition_vi: người thực sự kiểm soát một tổ chức, một quốc gia, v.v. trái ngược với người chịu trách nhiệm về mặt pháp lý

senses.definition: the people who control an organization, a country, etc.

examples.x: The powers that be are still trying to decide what should be done.

senses.definition_vi: những người kiểm soát một tổ chức, một quốc gia, v.v.

senses.definition: to win an election by a large number of votes; to make somebody win an election with a large number of votes
senses.definition_vi: thắng một cuộc bầu cử với số phiếu bầu lớn; làm cho ai đó thắng một cuộc bầu cử với số phiếu bầu lớn

senses.definition: to supply a machine or vehicle with the energy that makes it work

examples.x: The aircraft is powered by a jet engine.
The mill’s machinery is powered by waterwheels.
The plant generates enough energy to power a town of 6 000 people.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp năng lượng cho một máy móc hoặc phương tiện giao thông để nó hoạt động

senses.definition: to move or move something very quickly and with great power in a particular direction

examples.x: He powered through the water.
She powered her way into the lead.
He powered his header past the goalie.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc di chuyển cái gì đó rất nhanh và với sức mạnh lớn theo một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: being able to control and influence people and events

examples.x: an incredibly powerful organization
extremely/immensely/enormously powerful

She is still a powerful figure in the party.
a rich and powerful man
Fortunately we have some powerful allies.
Over time these groups have grown more powerful.
Europe has become increasingly powerful on the world stage.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng kiểm soát và ảnh hưởng đến con người và sự kiện

senses.definition: having great power or force; very effective

examples.x: a powerful engine
a powerful voice
a powerful telescope
A huge and powerful storm is on track to hit Florida.
I traded my computer in for a more powerful model.
Capitalism is an immensely powerful force in modern society.
Gene technology is a very powerful tool.
Humour can be a powerful weapon.

senses.definition_vi: có sức mạnh hoặc lực lượng lớn; rất hiệu quả

senses.definition: having a strong effect on your thoughts, feelings or body

examples.x: a powerful image/symbol/speech
He was prescribed a more powerful painkiller.
Fear is a powerful emotion.
Her background has had a powerful influence on her film-making.
A successful prosecution would send a powerful message.

senses.definition_vi: có tác động mạnh mẽ đến suy nghĩ, cảm xúc hoặc cơ thể của bạn

senses.definition: physically strong

examples.x: a powerful body
a powerful athlete
When she trots she covers ground like a powerful horse rather than a pony.

senses.definition_vi: mạnh mẽ về thể chất

senses.definition: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories

examples.x: to have gained practical experience of the work

What are the practical implications of the proposal?
There are some obvious practical applications of the research.

Yoga helps with practical matters such as injury prevention.
Of how much practical use was the conference?
Try to find a course which will allow you to develop the practical skills employers want.
The fog could present some practical difficulties.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các tình huống thực tế thay vì ý tưởng hoặc lý thuyết

senses.definition: right or sensible; likely to be successful

examples.x: I soon realized that it would have been more practical to walk.
It wouldn't be practical for us to go all that way just for the weekend.
It was difficult to find a practical solution to the problem.
The government is taking practical steps to deal with this issue.
Travel by boat was often faster and more practical than travel along the primitive roads.

senses.definition_vi: đúng đắn hoặc hợp lý; có khả năng thành công

senses.definition: useful or suitable

examples.x: a practical little car, ideal for the city
Cool, loose-fitting clothes are practical in a hot climate.
a briefcase that is practical for both travelling and days at the office
a feature that makes the system more practical

senses.definition_vi: hữu ích hoặc phù hợp

senses.definition: sensible and realistic

examples.x: Let's be practical and work out the cost first.
He always adopted a severely practical tone.
Sarah is quite practical about love and relationships.

senses.definition_vi: thực tế và hợp lý

senses.definition: good at making or repairing things

examples.x: Bob's very practical. He does all the odd jobs around the house.

senses.definition_vi: giỏi trong việc chế tạo hoặc sửa chữa đồ vật

senses.definition: almost complete or total

examples.x: She married a practical stranger.
They’re a practical certainty to win the game.

senses.definition_vi: gần như hoàn toàn hoặc toàn bộ

senses.definition: used when you are stating what the reality of a situation is

examples.x: There's still another ten minutes of the game to go, but for practical purposes it's already over.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn nêu thực tế của một tình huống

senses.definition: doing an activity or training regularly so that you can improve your skill; the time you spend doing this

examples.x: conversation practice
It takes a lot of practice to play the violin well.
There's a basketball practice every Friday evening.
She does an hour's piano practice every day.
With practice you will become more skilled.
I've had a lot of practice in saying ‘no’ recently!
It takes years of practice to get it right.
We had an extra practice session on Friday.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một hoạt động hoặc đào tạo thường xuyên để bạn có thể cải thiện kỹ năng của mình; thời gian bạn dành để làm điều này

senses.definition: action rather than ideas

examples.x: the theory and practice of teaching
She's determined to put her new ideas into practice.
the complications that arise in actual practice

senses.definition_vi: hành động thay vì ý tưởng

senses.definition: a way of doing something that is the usual or expected way in a particular organization or situation

examples.x: Wearing gloves should be standard practice when handling pesticides.
These methods remain current practice.
It is a common practice to include recommendations for further action in such reports.
Everyone knows it is good business practice to listen to your customers.
childcare policy and practice
a review of pay and working practices
Religious practices differ from group to group.
I am constantly adopting new practices on my farm.
The government has changed its accounting practices.
We will follow the practice of going in alphabetical order.
The company has ended its practice of pumping raw sewage out to sea.

senses.definition_vi: một cách làm điều gì đó theo cách thông thường hoặc được mong đợi trong một tổ chức hoặc tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: a thing that is done regularly; a habit or a custom

examples.x: the German practice of giving workers a say in how their company is run

examples.cf: it is somebody's practice to do something
examples.x: It is his practice to read several books a week.

senses.definition_vi: một điều được thực hiện thường xuyên; một thói quen hoặc một phong tục

senses.definition: the work or the business of some professional people such as doctors, dentists and lawyers; the place where they work

examples.x: the practice of medicine
clinical/medical practice
Students should have prior experience of veterinary practice.
My solicitor is no longer in practice.
a successful medical/dental/law practice

senses.definition_vi: công việc hoặc hoạt động kinh doanh của một số người chuyên nghiệp như bác sĩ, nha sĩ và luật sư; nơi họ làm việc

senses.definition: to be/become less good at doing something than you were because you have not spent time doing it recently

examples.x: Don't ask me to speak French! I'm out of practice.
If you don't play regularly you soon get out of practice.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên kém giỏi hơn trong việc làm điều gì đó so với trước đây vì bạn đã không dành thời gian làm điều đó gần đây

senses.definition: in reality

examples.x: Prisoners have legal rights, but in practice these rights are not always respected.
The idea sounds fine in theory, but would it work in practice?

senses.definition_vi: trong thực tế

senses.definition: a way of encouraging people by telling them that if you do an activity regularly and try to improve your skill, you will become very good at it
senses.definition_vi: một cách khuyến khích mọi người bằng cách nói với họ rằng nếu bạn thực hiện một hoạt động thường xuyên và cố gắng cải thiện kỹ năng của mình, bạn sẽ trở nên rất giỏi về nó

senses.definition: to do an activity or train regularly so that you can improve your skill

examples.x: You need to practise every day.
She's practising for her piano exam.
I've been practising my serve for weeks.
She diligently practised her violin every day.
He usually wants to practise his English on me.
I learned hairdressing by practising on my sister.
Practise reversing the car into the garage.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một hoạt động hoặc đào tạo thường xuyên để bạn có thể cải thiện kỹ năng của mình

senses.definition: to work as a doctor, lawyer, etc.

examples.x: There are over 50 000 solicitors practising in England and Wales.
She practised as a barrister for many years.
He was banned from practising medicine.
She practised law for more than a decade.

senses.definition_vi: làm việc như một bác sĩ, luật sư, v.v.

senses.definition: to do something regularly as part of your normal behaviour

examples.x: to practise self-restraint/safe sex
Do you still practise your religion?

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó thường xuyên như một phần hành vi bình thường của bạn

senses.definition: to do the things yourself that you tell other people to do
senses.definition_vi: tự mình làm những điều mà bạn bảo người khác làm

senses.definition: a person who works in a profession, especially medicine or law

examples.x: dental practitioners
a qualified practitioner

senses.definition_vi: một người làm việc trong một ngành nghề, đặc biệt là y học hoặc luật

senses.definition: a person who regularly does a particular activity, especially one that requires skill

examples.x: one of the greatest practitioners of science fiction

senses.definition_vi: một người thường xuyên thực hiện một hoạt động cụ thể, đặc biệt là hoạt động đòi hỏi kỹ năng

senses.definition: words that show that you approve of and admire somebody/something

examples.x: The team coach singled out two players for special praise.
His teachers are full of praise for the progress he's making.
His latest movie has won high praise from the critics.
He received widespread praise for his performance from fans on social media.
Critics heaped/lavished/showered praise on her latest movie.
to deserve/earn/garner praise
We have nothing but praise for the way they handled the investigation.
She wrote poems in praise of freedom.
She left with their praises ringing in her ears.
They always sing his praises (= praise him very highly).

senses.definition_vi: những lời thể hiện sự chấp thuận và ngưỡng mộ của bạn đối với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the expression of thanks to or respect for God

examples.x: hymns/songs of praise
joyous singing and praise to God
Praise be (to God)! (= expressing belief or joy)

senses.definition_vi: sự bày tỏ lòng biết ơn hoặc sự tôn trọng đối với Chúa

senses.definition: to praise somebody/something only a little, in order to show that you do not really like them/it
senses.definition_vi: chỉ khen ai đó/điều gì đó một chút, để thể hiện rằng bạn không thực sự thích họ/nó

senses.definition: to say that you approve of and admire somebody/something

examples.x: She praised his cooking.
a highly praised film
He praised his team for their performance.
They were praised by police for reporting the theft.
Critics praised the work as highly original.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn chấp thuận và ngưỡng mộ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to express your thanks to or your respect for God

examples.x: Praise the Lord.
Allah be praised.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ lòng biết ơn hoặc sự tôn trọng đối với Chúa

senses.definition: to praise somebody/something a lot

examples.x: Her manager praised her to the skies.

senses.definition_vi: khen ngợi ai đó/điều gì đó rất nhiều

senses.definition: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help

examples.x: They knelt down and prayed.
I'll pray for you.
to pray for peace
She prayed to God for an end to her sufferings.
I prayed to the Lord and hoped for the best.
We prayed (that) she would recover from her illness.
He prayed to be forgiven.
‘Please God don't let it happen,’ she prayed.

senses.definition_vi: nói chuyện với Chúa, đặc biệt là để bày tỏ lòng biết ơn hoặc cầu xin sự giúp đỡ

senses.definition: to hope very much that something will happen

examples.x: We're praying for good weather on Saturday.
I prayed that nobody would notice my mistake.
She hoped and prayed that Jessie would be back the next day.

senses.definition_vi: rất hy vọng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: words that you say to God giving thanks or asking for help

examples.x: to say your prayers
prayers for the sick
We offer our prayers for all those who have died in war.
He arrived at that very moment, as if in answer to her prayer.
Their prayers were answered and the child was found safe and well.
She stopped saying nightly prayers to God.

senses.definition_vi: những lời bạn nói với Chúa để bày tỏ lòng biết ơn hoặc cầu xin sự giúp đỡ

senses.definition: a fixed form of words that you can say when you speak to God

examples.x: It was a prayer she had learnt as a child.

senses.definition_vi: một hình thức từ ngữ cố định mà bạn có thể nói khi nói chuyện với Chúa

senses.definition: the act or habit of praying

examples.x: They knelt in prayer.
We believe in the power of prayer.
They held a prayer vigil throughout the night.
spiritual healing through prayer
a national day of prayer

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc thói quen cầu nguyện

senses.definition: a religious meeting that takes place regularly in which people say prayers

examples.x: Muslims attend Friday prayers at the mosque.

senses.definition_vi: một buổi lễ tôn giáo diễn ra thường xuyên, trong đó mọi người đọc kinh cầu nguyện

senses.definition: a thing that you hope for very much

examples.x: My prayer is that one day he will walk again.

senses.definition_vi: một điều mà bạn hy vọng rất nhiều

senses.definition: with only a very slight chance of success
senses.definition_vi: với cơ hội thành công rất nhỏ

senses.definition: to give a religious talk in a public place, especially in a church during a service

examples.x: She preached to the congregation about forgiveness.
The minister preached a sermon on the parable of the lost sheep.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết giảng một bài nói chuyện tôn giáo ở nơi công cộng, đặc biệt là trong nhà thờ trong một buổi lễ

senses.definition: to tell people about a particular religion, way of life, system, etc. in order to persuade them to accept it

examples.x: to preach the word of God
He preached the virtues of capitalism to us.
She preached about the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.

senses.definition_vi: nói cho mọi người biết về một tôn giáo, lối sống, hệ thống, v.v. cụ thể để thuyết phục họ chấp nhận nó

senses.definition: to give somebody advice on moral standards, behaviour, etc., especially in a way that they find annoying or boring

examples.x: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to preach.
You're preaching at me again!

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra lời khuyên về các tiêu chuẩn đạo đức, hành vi, v.v. cho ai đó, đặc biệt là theo cách mà họ thấy phiền hoặc nhàm chán

senses.definition: to do the things yourself that you tell other people to do
senses.definition_vi: tự mình làm những điều mà bạn bảo người khác làm

senses.definition: to speak to people in support of views that they already hold

examples.x: I realize I may be preaching to the converted, but I think he's gorgeous.

senses.definition_vi: nói chuyện với mọi người ủng hộ những quan điểm mà họ đã có

senses.definition: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order

examples.x: the years preceding the war
His resignation was preceded by weeks of speculation.
She preceded me in the job.
in the moments which immediately preceded the earthquake

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra trước một điều gì đó hoặc đứng trước một điều gì đó/ai đó theo thứ tự

senses.definition: to go in front of somebody

examples.x: She preceded him out of the room.

senses.definition_vi: đi trước ai đó

senses.definition: to do or say something to introduce something else

examples.x: She preceded her speech with a vote of thanks to the committee.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để giới thiệu một điều khác

senses.definition: an official action or decision that has happened in the past and that is seen as an example or a rule to be followed in a similar situation later

examples.x: The ruling set a precedent for future libel cases.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc quyết định chính thức đã xảy ra trong quá khứ và được xem là một ví dụ hoặc quy tắc để tuân theo trong tình huống tương tự sau này

senses.definition: a similar action or event that happened earlier

examples.x: historical precedents
There is no precedent for a disaster of this scale.
Such protests are without precedent in recent history.
The achievements of this period were without precedent in history.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc sự kiện tương tự đã xảy ra trước đó

senses.definition: the way that things have always been done

examples.x: to break with precedent (= to do something in a different way)

senses.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ luôn được thực hiện

senses.definition: rare and worth a lot of money

examples.x: a precious vase
The crown was set with precious jewels—diamonds, rubies and emeralds.
precious metals

senses.definition_vi: hiếm và đáng giá nhiều tiền

senses.definition: valuable or important and not to be wasted

examples.x: Clean water is a precious commodity in that part of the world.
You're wasting precious time!

senses.definition_vi: có giá trị hoặc quan trọng và không nên lãng phí

senses.definition: loved or valued very much

examples.x: precious memories/possessions
You are infinitely precious to me.

senses.definition_vi: được yêu mến hoặc coi trọng rất nhiều

senses.definition: used to show you are angry that another person thinks something is very important

examples.x: I didn't touch your precious car!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để thể hiện sự tức giận của bạn rằng người khác cho rằng điều gì đó rất quan trọng

senses.definition: very formal, exaggerated and not natural in what you say and do
senses.definition_vi: rất trang trọng, cường điệu và không tự nhiên trong lời nói và hành động của bạn

senses.definition: clear and accurate

examples.x: precise details/instructions/measurements

I can be reasonably precise about the time of the incident.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và chính xác

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something happens at a particular time or in a particular way

examples.x: We were just talking about her when, at that precise moment, she walked in.
Doctors found it hard to establish the precise nature of her illness.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều gì đó xảy ra vào một thời điểm hoặc theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: taking care to be exact and accurate, especially about small details

examples.x: a skilled and precise worker
small, precise movements
We've tried to make the process as precise as possible.
She's rather prim and precise.

senses.definition_vi: cẩn thận để chính xác và đúng đắn, đặc biệt là về các chi tiết nhỏ

senses.definition: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned

examples.x: The shelf is about a metre long—well, 98cm, to be precise.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và chính xác hơn về một điều gì đó bạn vừa đề cập

senses.definition: exactly

examples.x: They look precisely the same to me.
That's precisely what I meant.
It's not clear precisely how the accident happened.
The meeting starts at 2 o'clock precisely.

senses.definition_vi: chính xác

senses.definition: accurately; carefully

examples.x: to describe something precisely
She pronounced the word very slowly and precisely.

senses.definition_vi: chính xác; cẩn thận

senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is very true or obvious

examples.x: It's precisely because I care about you that I don't like you staying out late.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng một điều gì đó rất đúng hoặc hiển nhiên

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you agree with a statement, especially because you think it is obvious or is similar to what you have just said

examples.x: ‘It's not that easy, is it?’ ‘No, precisely.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đồng ý với một tuyên bố, đặc biệt là vì bạn cho rằng nó hiển nhiên hoặc tương tự như những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about something you have just mentioned

examples.x: The problem is due to discipline, or, more precisely, the lack of discipline, in schools.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang cung cấp thông tin chi tiết và chính xác hơn về một điều gì đó bạn vừa đề cập

senses.definition: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful

examples.x: Her writing is imaginative but lacks precision.
He chose his words with precision.
done with mathematical precision
Historians can’t estimate the date with any (degree of) precision.
precision instruments/tools

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng của sự chính xác, đúng đắn và cẩn thận

senses.definition: an animal that kills and eats other animals

examples.x: Some animals have no natural predators.
the relationship between predator and prey

senses.definition_vi: một loài động vật giết và ăn các loài động vật khác

senses.definition: a person or an organization that uses weaker people for their own advantage

examples.x: to protect domestic industry from foreign predators

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một tổ chức lợi dụng những người yếu thế hơn cho lợi ích của riêng mình

senses.definition: a person who did a job before somebody else

examples.x: The new president reversed many of the policies of his predecessor.
her immediate predecessor in the post
my predecessor at the Ministry of Defence

senses.definition_vi: một người đã làm một công việc trước người khác

senses.definition: a thing, such as a machine, that has been followed or replaced by something else

examples.x: This computer has a larger memory than its predecessor.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ, chẳng hạn như máy móc, đã được thay thế hoặc kế nhiệm bởi một thứ khác

senses.definition: to say that something will happen in the future

examples.x: a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
Nobody could predict the outcome.
to predict the future
He predicts a bright future for the business in the next financial year.
The party is predicting a majority of 20 seats.
It is impossible to predict what will happen.
She predicted (that) the election result would be close.
He predicted (that) it would be a bestseller.
It was predicted that inflation would continue to fall.

examples.cf: somebody/something is predicted to do something
examples.x: The trial is predicted to last for months.
This figure is predicted to rise to one billion by the year 2030.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng một điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai

senses.definition: if something is predictable, you know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like

examples.x: a predictable result
The ending of the book was entirely predictable.
The disease follows a highly predictable pattern.
In March and April, the weather is much less predictable.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó có thể đoán trước, bạn biết trước rằng nó sẽ xảy ra hoặc nó sẽ như thế nào

senses.definition: behaving or happening in a way that you would expect and therefore boring

examples.x: He's very nice, but I find him rather dull and predictable.
Rock music is getting so predictable these days.
She had been in a number of predictable sitcoms.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử hoặc xảy ra theo cách mà bạn mong đợi và do đó nhàm chán

senses.definition: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement

examples.x: The results of the experiment confirmed our predictions.
I've learned not to make predictions about the weather.
It's difficult to make accurate predictions about the effects on the environment.
Experts preview the game and offer their prediction on the outcome.
Not many people agree with the government's prediction that the economy will improve.
Their prediction of fifty million visitors turned out to be optimistic.
What are your predictions for the economy?
Skilled readers make use of context and prediction.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố nói những gì bạn nghĩ sẽ xảy ra; hành động đưa ra một tuyên bố như vậy

senses.definition: mostly; mainly

examples.x: She works in a predominantly male environment.

senses.definition_vi: hầu hết; chủ yếu

senses.definition: to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else because you like it better

examples.x: ‘Coffee or tea?’ ‘I'd prefer tea, thanks.’
I would prefer it if you didn't tell anyone.
A local firm is to be preferred.
A short-term fixed rate is the preferred option.
I much prefer jazz to rock music.
I prefer quality to quantity.
Many people prefer streaming over other forms of consuming media.
Relevant experience is preferred over formal education.
I prefer my coffee black.
I much prefer to travel by train.
The donor prefers to remain anonymous.
I prefer not to think about it.
She won't discuss her plans in detail, preferring instead to wait until after the election.
Would you prefer me to stay?
I prefer playing in defence.
I would prefer that you did not mention my name.

senses.definition_vi: thích một thứ hoặc một người hơn thứ khác; chọn một thứ thay vì thứ khác vì bạn thích nó hơn

senses.definition: to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.x: Police have brought a charge of dangerous driving against the man.

She laid charges against the firm for not complying with the regulations.

senses.definition_vi: buộc tội ai đó một cách chính thức về một tội danh để có thể đưa ra xét xử tại tòa án

senses.definition: a greater interest in or desire for somebody/something than somebody/something else

examples.x: It's a matter of personal preference.

Many people expressed a strong preference for the original plan.
Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.

senses.definition_vi: sự quan tâm hoặc mong muốn lớn hơn đối với ai đó/điều gì đó hơn là đối với ai đó/điều gì đó khác

senses.definition: a thing that is liked better or best

examples.x: a study of consumer preferences

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được thích hơn hoặc thích nhất

senses.definition: to treat somebody/something in a way that gives them an advantage over other people or things

examples.x: Preference will be given to graduates of this university.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với ai đó/điều gì đó theo cách mang lại cho họ lợi thế hơn những người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: rather than somebody/something

examples.x: She was chosen in preference to her sister.
They bought French planes in preference to British ones.

senses.definition_vi: thay vì ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the state of being pregnant

examples.x: a pregnancy test
Many women experience sickness during pregnancy.
unplanned/unwanted pregnancies
the increase in teenage pregnancies

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng mang thai

senses.definition: having a baby or young animal developing inside her/its body

examples.x: My wife is pregnant.
I was pregnant with our third child at the time.
a heavily pregnant woman (= one whose baby is nearly ready to be born)
to get/become/fall pregnant
He got his girlfriend pregnant and they're getting married.
She's six months pregnant.

senses.definition_vi: có em bé hoặc con non đang phát triển bên trong cơ thể của cô ấy/nó

senses.definition: full of a quality or feeling

examples.x: Her silences were pregnant with criticism.

senses.definition_vi: chứa đầy một phẩm chất hoặc cảm xúc
