She managed to preserve her sense of humour under very trying circumstances.
He was insistent on preserving the integrity of the brand.

senses.definition_vi: duy trì một phẩm chất, đặc điểm cụ thể, v.v.; đảm bảo rằng một cái gì đó được giữ gìn

senses.definition: to keep something in its original state in good condition

examples.x: a perfectly preserved 14th-century house
Is he really 60? He's remarkably well preserved.
We need knowledgeable gallery curators to preserve great masterpieces for posterity.
This vase has been preserved intact.

senses.definition_vi: giữ một thứ gì đó ở trạng thái ban đầu, trong tình trạng tốt

senses.definition: to prevent something, especially food, from decaying (= being destroyed by natural processes) by treating it in a particular way

examples.x: Wax polish preserves wood and leather.
preserved lemons
olives preserved in brine
an attempt to preserve the corpse from decomposition

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là thực phẩm, bị hư hỏng (= bị phá hủy bởi các quá trình tự nhiên) bằng cách xử lý nó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to keep somebody/something alive, or safe from harm or danger

examples.x: The society was set up to preserve endangered species from extinction.

senses.definition_vi: giữ cho ai đó/thứ gì đó còn sống, hoặc an toàn khỏi bị tổn hại hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: to lead or be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.

examples.x: the presiding judge
They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
The party presided over one of the worst economic declines in the country's history (= it was in power when the decline happened).

senses.definition_vi: lãnh đạo hoặc phụ trách một cuộc họp, buổi lễ, v.v.

senses.definition: the job of being president of a country or an organization; the period of time somebody holds this job

examples.x: the current holder of the EU presidency
She hopes to be the first woman elected to the presidency of the United States.
He was a White House official during the Biden presidency.

senses.definition_vi: công việc của một tổng thống của một quốc gia hoặc một tổ chức; khoảng thời gian một người giữ chức vụ này

senses.definition: the leader of a republic, for example the US

examples.x: Several presidents attended the funeral.
the President of the United States
President Biden visited the country twice.
Do you have any comment, Mr President?
France elected a new president in 2017.
Ford became president following Nixon's resignation.
She should run for president.
the former South African president, Nelson Mandela
He was sworn in as President on August 31.

senses.definition_vi: người lãnh đạo một nước cộng hòa, ví dụ như Hoa Kỳ

senses.definition: the person in charge of some organizations, clubs, colleges, etc.

examples.x: to be made president of the students’ union
She travels extensively in her role as President of the World Wide Fund for Nature.

senses.definition_vi: người đứng đầu một số tổ chức, câu lạc bộ, trường đại học, v.v.

senses.definition: the person in charge of a bank or a commercial organization

examples.x: the bank president
the president of Columbia Pictures

senses.definition_vi: người đứng đầu một ngân hàng hoặc một tổ chức thương mại

senses.definition: connected with the position or activities of a president

examples.x: a presidential campaign/candidate/election
a presidential system of government
a presidential year (= one in which the people vote for the next president of the country)

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến vị trí hoặc hoạt động của một tổng thống

senses.definition: newspapers and magazines

examples.x: the local/national/foreign press
the popular/tabloid press (= newspapers with a lot of pictures and stories about famous people)
the music/sporting press (= newspapers and magazines about music/sport)
The mainstream press is/are ignoring this story.
Unlike the American, the British press operates on a national scale.
The case has been widely reported in the press.
the freedom of the Press/press freedom (= the freedom to report any events and express opinions)
The event is bound to attract wide press coverage (= it will be written about in many newspapers).
According to French press reports, three people have been killed.
a White House press briefing

senses.definition_vi: báo chí và tạp chí

senses.definition: the journalists and photographers who work for newspapers and magazines

examples.x: The Press was/were not allowed to attend the trial.
She has been harassed by the press, who desperately need a story.
He told the press that there had been ‘further progress’.
She told them not to talk to the press.

senses.definition_vi: các nhà báo và nhiếp ảnh gia làm việc cho báo chí và tạp chí

senses.definition: the type or amount of reports that newspapers write about somebody/something

examples.x: The airline has had a bad press recently (= journalists have written unpleasant things about it).
The demonstration got very little press.
His latest novel didn't get (a) very good press (= was not praised in the media).

senses.definition_vi: loại hoặc số lượng các bài báo mà báo chí viết về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a machine for printing books, newspapers, etc.; the process of printing them

examples.x: We were able to watch the books rolling off the presses.
These prices are correct at the time of going to press.
a story that is hot off the press (= has just appeared in the newspapers)

senses.definition_vi: một máy để in sách, báo, v.v.; quá trình in chúng

senses.definition: a business that prints and publishes books

examples.x: Oxford University Press

senses.definition_vi: một doanh nghiệp in và xuất bản sách

senses.definition: a piece of equipment that is used for creating pressure on things, to make them flat or to get liquid from them

examples.x: a trouser press
an olive press

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị được sử dụng để tạo áp lực lên mọi thứ, để làm phẳng chúng hoặc để lấy chất lỏng từ chúng

senses.definition: an act of pushing something with your hand or with a tool that you are holding

examples.x: He gave the bell another press.
Those shirts need a press (= with an iron).

senses.definition_vi: hành động ấn một thứ gì đó bằng tay của bạn hoặc bằng một công cụ bạn đang cầm

senses.definition: a large number of people or things competing for space or movement

examples.x: the press of bodies all moving the same way
Among the press of cars he glimpsed a taxi.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn người hoặc vật cạnh tranh không gian hoặc di chuyển

senses.definition: a large cupboard, usually with shelves, for holding clothes, books, etc.
senses.definition_vi: một tủ lớn, thường có kệ, để đựng quần áo, sách, v.v.

senses.definition: to push part of a device, etc. in order to make it work

examples.x: to press a button/key
He pressed the lid firmly shut.
Press here to open.
She pressed down hard on the gas pedal.

senses.definition_vi: ấn một phần của thiết bị, v.v. để làm cho nó hoạt động

senses.definition: to push something closely against something; to be pushed in this way

examples.x: She pressed her face against the window.
He pressed a handkerchief to his nose.
She pressed her lips together.
Her lips softly pressed my cheek.
His body was pressing against hers.
She pressed down harder on the paper.

senses.definition_vi: ấn một thứ gì đó sát vào một thứ khác; bị ấn theo cách này

senses.definition: to put something in a place by pushing it

examples.x: He pressed a coin into her hand and moved on.
She pressed a finger into the dough.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một thứ gì đó vào một vị trí bằng cách ấn nó

senses.definition: to put gentle pressure on somebody’s hand or arm, especially to show care or kind feelings

examples.x: He gently pressed her arm, then left.

senses.definition_vi: tạo áp lực nhẹ lên tay hoặc cánh tay của ai đó, đặc biệt là để thể hiện sự quan tâm hoặc tình cảm tốt đẹp

senses.definition: to move in the direction mentioned by pushing

examples.x: The photographers pressed around the royal visitors.
A host of unwelcome thoughts were pressing in on him.
The crowd pressed forward.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển theo hướng được đề cập bằng cách ấn

senses.definition: to make strong efforts to persuade or force somebody to do something

examples.x: If pressed, he will admit that he knew about the affair.
The bank is pressing us for repayment of the loan.
They are pressing us to make a quick decision.
Don't let yourself be pressed into doing something you don't like.
I did not press him further on the issue.
‘Are you sure?’ she pressed gently.

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực mạnh mẽ để thuyết phục hoặc buộc ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to express or repeat something with force

examples.x: I don't want to press the point, but you do owe me $200.
She is still pressing her claim for compensation.
They were determined to press their case at the highest level.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ hoặc lặp lại một điều gì đó một cách mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to make something flat or smooth by using force or putting something heavy on top

examples.x: The easiest way to press flowers is between the pages of a book.
Press the soil flat with the back of a spade.

senses.definition_vi: làm phẳng hoặc mịn một thứ gì đó bằng cách sử dụng lực hoặc đặt vật nặng lên trên

senses.definition: to make clothes smooth using a hot iron

examples.x: My suit needs pressing.
his immaculately pressed suit

senses.definition_vi: làm phẳng quần áo bằng bàn là nóng

senses.definition: to get the juice out of fruit or vegetables by using force or weight
senses.definition_vi: lấy nước ép từ trái cây hoặc rau bằng cách sử dụng lực hoặc trọng lượng

senses.definition: to make something from a material, using pressure

examples.x: to press a CD
The car bodies are pressed out of sheets of metal.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một thứ gì đó từ một vật liệu, sử dụng áp lực

senses.definition: to accuse somebody formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court

examples.x: Police have brought a charge of dangerous driving against the man.
Many victims of crime are reluctant to press charges against their attackers.
She laid charges against the firm for not complying with the regulations.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức buộc tội ai đó phạm tội để có thể xét xử tại tòa

senses.definition: to do exactly the right things to please somebody

examples.x: a new satirical comedy show that presses all the right buttons

senses.definition_vi: làm đúng những điều cần thiết để làm hài lòng ai đó

senses.definition: to say hello to people by shaking hands
senses.definition_vi: chào hỏi mọi người bằng cách bắt tay

senses.definition: to get as much advantage as possible from a situation by attacking or arguing in a determined way

examples.x: to press home an attack/an argument/a point
Simon saw she was hesitating and pressed home his advantage.

senses.definition_vi: thu được nhiều lợi thế nhất có thể từ một tình huống bằng cách tấn công hoặc tranh luận một cách quyết đoán

senses.definition: to use somebody/something for a purpose that they were not trained or intended for because there is nobody or nothing else available

examples.x: Every type of boat was pressed into service to rescue passengers from the sinking ferry.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng ai đó/thứ gì đó cho một mục đích mà họ không được đào tạo hoặc dự định vì không có ai hoặc không có gì khác có sẵn

senses.definition: to react in a sudden or extreme way to something unexpected that has frightened you

examples.x: The prime minister pressed the panic button yesterday as Britain’s economy plunged deeper into crisis.

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng đột ngột hoặc cực đoan với một điều gì đó bất ngờ khiến bạn sợ hãi

senses.definition: to push the reset button on a machine or device

examples.x: When the game is over, press reset to start a new game.

senses.definition_vi: nhấn nút đặt lại trên máy hoặc thiết bị

senses.definition: to make an important change in your life, career, etc. by starting again with a fresh approach

examples.x: Working from home during Covid gave many people a chance to press reset and make changes in their lives.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện một thay đổi quan trọng trong cuộc sống, sự nghiệp, v.v. của bạn bằng cách bắt đầu lại với một cách tiếp cận mới

senses.definition: the act of trying to persuade or to force somebody to do something

examples.x: The pressure for change continued to mount.
We are determined to keep up the pressure on the other member states.

examples.cf: pressure on somebody to do something
examples.x: There is intense pressure on her to resign.
In every society there is strong pressure to conform.
Do you feel any pressure to dress in a certain way?
We must bring pressure to bear on our government to reverse this decision.
The company is facing increasing pressure from shareholders
The government eventually bowed to popular pressure (= they agreed to do what people were trying to get them to do).

senses.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng thuyết phục hoặc buộc ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: difficulties and worries that are caused by the need to achieve or to behave in a particular way

examples.x: You need to be able to handle pressure in this job.
She was unable to attend because of the pressure of work.
How can anyone enjoy the pressures of city life?
The economic pressures on small businesses are intense.

senses.definition_vi: những khó khăn và lo lắng do nhu cầu phải đạt được hoặc cư xử theo một cách nhất định gây ra

senses.definition: the force or weight with which something presses against something else

examples.x: The nurse applied pressure to his arm to stop the bleeding.
The barriers gave way under the pressure of the crowd.
Last year he had brain surgery to relieve pressure from a blood clot.

senses.definition_vi: lực hoặc trọng lượng mà một vật tác dụng lên vật khác

senses.definition: the force produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a container or a limited space; the amount of this

examples.x: air/water pressure
Check the tyre pressure (= the amount of air in a tyre) regularly.
a pressure gauge (= an instrument used for measuring the pressure of a liquid or a gas)

senses.definition_vi: lực sinh ra bởi một lượng khí hoặc chất lỏng nhất định trong một vật chứa hoặc một không gian hạn chế; lượng này

senses.definition: the effect that something has on the way a situation develops, especially when this causes problems

examples.x: This puts upward pressure on prices.
The high unemployment rate was exerting downward pressure on wage growth.
These measures are intended to relieve the pressure on the prison system.
They raised the starting threshold for income tax to ease the pressure on family budgets.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng của một cái gì đó đến cách một tình huống phát triển, đặc biệt là khi điều này gây ra vấn đề

senses.definition: the force of the atmosphere on the earth’s surface

examples.x: A band of high/low pressure is moving across the country.

senses.definition_vi: lực của khí quyển tác dụng lên bề mặt trái đất

senses.definition: to force or to try to persuade somebody to do something

examples.x: Advertisements put pressure on girls to be thin.

senses.definition_vi: buộc hoặc cố gắng thuyết phục ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: if a liquid or a gas is kept under pressure, it is forced into a container so that when the container is opened, the liquid or gas escapes quickly

examples.x: Draught beer is pumped out of the barrel under pressure.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một chất lỏng hoặc khí được giữ dưới áp suất, nó sẽ bị ép vào vật chứa để khi vật chứa được mở ra, chất lỏng hoặc khí sẽ thoát ra nhanh chóng

senses.definition: being forced to do something

examples.x: The director is under increasing pressure to resign.
Hospital staff are coming under pressure to work longer hours.

senses.definition_vi: bị buộc phải làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: made to feel anxious about something you have to do

examples.x: The team performs well under pressure.
He's felt under pressure since his wife had the operation.

senses.definition_vi: bị làm cho lo lắng về điều gì đó bạn phải làm

senses.definition: respected and admired as very important or of very high quality

examples.x: a prestigious award
a highly prestigious university
My parents wanted me to go to a more prestigious university.
the city’s most prestigious and exclusive hotel
The Gold Cup is one of the most prestigious events in the racing calendar.

senses.definition_vi: được tôn trọng và ngưỡng mộ vì rất quan trọng hoặc có chất lượng rất cao

senses.definition: used to say that you think that something is probably true

examples.x: Presumably this is where the accident happened.
You'll be taking the car, presumably?
I couldn't concentrate, presumably because I was so tired.
Presumably you’ll be leaving the children at home.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng

senses.definition: to suppose that something is true, although you do not have actual proof

examples.x: They are very expensive, I presume?
‘Is he still abroad?’ ‘I presume so.’
I presumed (that) he understood the rules.
Little is known of the youngest son; it is presumed that he died young.
I presumed him to be her husband.

senses.definition_vi: cho rằng điều gì đó là đúng, mặc dù bạn không có bằng chứng thực tế

senses.definition: to accept that something is true until it is shown not to be true, especially in court

examples.x: Twelve passengers are missing, presumed dead.
In English law, a person is presumed innocent until proved guilty.
We must presume innocence until we have proof of guilt.
We must presume them to be innocent until we have proof of guilt.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng cho đến khi nó được chứng minh là sai, đặc biệt là trong tòa án

senses.definition: to accept something as true or existing and to act on that basis

examples.x: The course seems to presume some previous knowledge of the subject.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận điều gì đó là đúng hoặc tồn tại và hành động dựa trên cơ sở đó

senses.definition: to behave in a way that shows a lack of respect by doing something that you have no right to do

examples.x: I wouldn't presume to tell you how to run your own business.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử thiếu tôn trọng bằng cách làm điều gì đó mà bạn không có quyền làm

senses.definition: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe something that is not true

examples.x: I'm tired of having to pretend all the time.
Of course I was wrong; it would be hypocritical to pretend otherwise.
He pretended to his family that everything was fine.
We pretended (that) nothing had happened.
She pretended (that) she was his niece.
I pretended to be asleep.
He pretended not to notice.
She didn't love him, though she pretended to.
She pretended an interest she did not feel.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử theo một cách nhất định, để khiến người khác tin vào điều không đúng

senses.definition: to imagine that something is true as part of a game

examples.x: They didn't have any real money so they had to pretend.
Let’s pretend (that) we’re astronauts.

senses.definition_vi: tưởng tượng rằng điều gì đó là đúng như một phần của trò chơi

senses.definition: to claim to be, do or have something, especially when this is not true

examples.x: I can't pretend to any great musical talent.
I don’t pretend (that) I know much about the subject, but…
The book doesn't pretend to be a great work of literature.

senses.definition_vi: khẳng định là, làm hoặc có cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi điều đó không đúng

senses.definition: attractive without being very beautiful

examples.x: a pretty face
a very pretty child
You look so pretty in that dress!
She's very attractive, though not conventionally pretty.

senses.definition_vi: dễ thương mà không quá xinh đẹp

senses.definition: attractive and pleasant to look at or to listen to without being large, beautiful or impressive

examples.x: pretty clothes
a pretty garden
Lydia—what a pretty name!
That's a pretty flower—what's it called?
The canal looked prettiest at night.
He was hired to make the company pretty and then sell it off.

senses.definition_vi: dễ thương và dễ nhìn hoặc dễ nghe mà không quá lớn, xinh đẹp hoặc ấn tượng

senses.definition: very pretty

examples.x: She’s as pretty as a picture.

senses.definition_vi: rất xinh đẹp

senses.definition: to reach a sad or difficult state

examples.x: I never thought things would come to this pretty pass.
Things have come to a pretty pass when we can’t afford to pay the heating bills!

senses.definition_vi: đạt đến một trạng thái buồn hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you have particular skills or qualities

examples.x: ‘I didn't know you could play the piano.’ ‘I'm not just a pretty face, you know!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn có các kỹ năng hoặc phẩm chất cụ thể

senses.definition: not pleasant to look at

examples.x: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!

senses.definition_vi: không dễ nhìn

senses.definition: a lot of money

examples.x: I bet that cost you a pretty penny.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền lớn

senses.definition: to some extent; fairly

examples.x: The game was pretty good.
I'm pretty sure I'll be going.
It's pretty hard to explain.
I'm going to have to find a new apartment pretty soon.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ nào đó; khá

senses.definition: very

examples.x: That performance was pretty impressive.
Things are looking pretty good!
The idea sounds pretty cool.
We were pretty disappointed with the quality of the food.

senses.definition_vi: rất

senses.definition: to be in a good situation, especially when others are not

examples.x: With profits at record levels, the company’s certainly sitting pretty this year.

senses.definition_vi: ở một tình huống tốt, đặc biệt là khi người khác thì không

senses.definition: almost; almost completely

examples.x: One dog looks pretty much like another to me.
He goes out pretty well every night.
The first stage is pretty near finished.

senses.definition_vi: hầu như; gần như hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to exist or be very common at a particular time or in a particular place

examples.x: We were horrified at the conditions prevailing in local prisons.
Those beliefs still prevail among certain social groups.

senses.definition_vi: tồn tại hoặc rất phổ biến tại một thời điểm hoặc địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to be accepted, especially after a struggle or an argument

examples.x: Justice will prevail over tyranny.
Fortunately, common sense prevailed.

senses.definition_vi: được chấp nhận, đặc biệt là sau một cuộc đấu tranh hoặc tranh cãi

senses.definition: to defeat an opponent, especially after a long struggle

examples.x: In a one-sided final, Spain prevailed against title-holder Croatia 40–34.
They wasted two penalties but still prevailed 2–1.

senses.definition_vi: đánh bại đối thủ, đặc biệt là sau một cuộc đấu tranh dài

senses.definition: the fact of existing or being very common at a particular time or in a particular place

examples.x: an increase in the prevalence of obesity in many countries

senses.definition_vi: thực tế của việc tồn tại hoặc rất phổ biến tại một thời điểm hoặc địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to stop somebody from doing something; to stop something from happening

examples.x: The accident could have been prevented.
Maddie would have joined the army if an injury had not prevented her.
The government took steps to prevent a scandal.
He is prevented by law from holding a licence.
Nothing would prevent him from speaking out against injustice.
Nothing would prevent him speaking out against injustice.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn ai đó làm điều gì đó; ngăn điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: the act of stopping something bad from happening

examples.x: accident/crime prevention
the prevention of disease
a fire prevention officer
a diabetes prevention programme

senses.definition_vi: (xem xét) bằng chứng từ cả hai phía của một lập luận, để tìm ra lý do hoặc kết quả có khả năng xảy ra nhất của một điều gì đó

The weather doesn't look very promising.
The research produced promising results.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy dấu hiệu của việc tốt hoặc thành công

senses.definition: to help sell a product, service, etc. or make it more popular by advertising it or offering it at a special price

examples.x: The band have gone on tour to promote their new album.
This trade fair will help businesses from Malawi to promote their products.
The area is being promoted as a tourist destination.

senses.definition_vi: giúp bán một sản phẩm, dịch vụ, v.v. hoặc làm cho nó trở nên phổ biến hơn bằng cách quảng cáo hoặc cung cấp nó với giá đặc biệt

senses.definition: to help something to happen or develop

examples.x: to promote democracy/peace/understanding/health
I applaud his efforts to promote world peace.
to promote the development/use of something
policies to promote economic growth
a campaign to promote awareness of environmental issues
The exhibition was intended to promote interest in contemporary sculpture.
We think football can help to promote the idea of a multicultural and multiethnic society.
Vietnam has actively promoted foreign investment.

senses.definition_vi: giúp một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc phát triển

senses.definition: to move somebody to a higher rank or more senior job

examples.x: She worked hard and was soon promoted.
He has been promoted to sergeant.
He was an experienced officer who had been promoted from the ranks.

examples.cf: promote somebody from something to something
examples.x: She was promoted from finance director to chief executive.

senses.definition_vi: chuyển ai đó lên một cấp bậc cao hơn hoặc một vị trí cấp cao hơn

senses.definition: to move a sports team from playing with one group of teams to playing in a better group

examples.x: They were promoted to the First Division last season.

senses.definition_vi: để di chuyển một đội thể thao từ việc thi đấu với một nhóm đội sang thi đấu trong một nhóm tốt hơn

senses.definition: a move to a more important job or rank in a company or an organization

examples.x: The new job is a promotion for him.
Her promotion to Sales Manager took everyone by surprise.
a job with excellent promotion prospects

senses.definition_vi: một sự thăng tiến lên một vị trí hoặc cấp bậc quan trọng hơn trong một công ty hoặc tổ chức

senses.definition: a move by a sports team from playing in one group of teams to playing in a better group

examples.x: the team’s promotion to the First Division

senses.definition_vi: một sự di chuyển của một đội thể thao từ việc thi đấu trong một nhóm đội sang thi đấu trong một nhóm tốt hơn

senses.definition: activities done in order to increase the sales of a product or service; a set of advertisements for a particular product or service

examples.x: Her job is mainly concerned with sales and promotion.
We are doing a special promotion of French cheeses.
We're doing a major book promotion at key bookshops this week.

senses.definition_vi: các hoạt động được thực hiện để tăng doanh số bán hàng của một sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ; một bộ quảng cáo cho một sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: activity that encourages people to believe in the value or importance of something, or that helps something to succeed

examples.x: a society for the promotion of religious tolerance
The new health promotion clinic will provide free check-ups.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động khuyến khích mọi người tin vào giá trị hoặc tầm quan trọng của một điều gì đó, hoặc giúp đỡ điều gì đó thành công

senses.definition: to make somebody decide to do something; to cause something to happen

examples.x: The discovery of the bomb prompted an increase in security.
His speech prompted an angry outburst from a man in the crowd.
Her father's struggles with mental health prompted her to pursue psychology as a career.

senses.definition_vi: để khiến ai đó quyết định làm điều gì đó; để gây ra điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to encourage somebody to speak by asking them questions or suggesting words that they could say

examples.x: She was too nervous to speak and had to be prompted.
The program will prompt you to enter data where required.
‘And then what happened?’ he prompted.

senses.definition_vi: để khuyến khích ai đó nói bằng cách đặt câu hỏi hoặc gợi ý những từ họ có thể nói

senses.definition: to follow the text of a play and remind the actors what the words are if they forget their lines
senses.definition_vi: để theo dõi lời thoại của một vở kịch và nhắc nhở các diễn viên những lời thoại nếu họ quên lời thoại của mình

senses.definition: to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way

examples.x: to pronounce a word/syllable/vowel/consonant
Very few people can pronounce my name correctly.
The ‘b’ in lamb is not pronounced.
I found it difficult to pronounce the name of the port.

senses.definition_vi: để tạo ra âm thanh của một từ hoặc chữ cái theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to give a judgement, opinion or statement formally, officially or publicly

examples.x: to pronounce an opinion
The judge will pronounce sentence today.
I hesitate to pronounce judgement in such a case.
She pronounced him the winner of the competition.
I now pronounce you husband and wife (= in a marriage ceremony).
She was pronounced dead on arrival at the hospital.
The jury pronounced him guilty of first-degree murder.
He pronounced the country to be in a state of war.
She pronounced that an error had been made.
‘It's pneumonia,’ he pronounced gravely.
The committee has pronounced in favour of the merger.
The judge pronounced for (= in favour of) the defendant.
My opinion in this case is that I must pronounce against this claim.

senses.definition_vi: để đưa ra một phán quyết, ý kiến hoặc tuyên bố một cách trang trọng, chính thức hoặc công khai

senses.definition: very obvious, easy to notice or strongly expressed

examples.x: He walked with a pronounced limp.
She has very pronounced views on art.

senses.definition_vi: rất rõ ràng, dễ nhận thấy hoặc được thể hiện mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: information, documents, etc. that show that something is true

examples.x: conclusive/definitive/scientific proof
The police suspected him of dealing drugs, but they didn't have any proof.
to require/need proof
Can you provide any proof of identity?
Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
These results are a further proof of his outstanding ability.
There is no proof that the knife belonged to her.
Today's unemployment figures are proof positive the government's economic plan isn't working.
In criminal cases the burden of proof (= requirement to provide proof) is on the prosecution.
plans to lower the standard of proof required to convict people of crimes under the Terrorism Act

senses.definition_vi: thông tin, tài liệu, v.v. cho thấy điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: the process of testing whether something is true or a fact

examples.x: Is the claim capable of proof?

senses.definition_vi: quá trình kiểm tra xem điều gì đó có đúng sự thật hay không

senses.definition: a way of proving that a statement is true or that what you have calculated is correct
senses.definition_vi: một cách để chứng minh rằng một tuyên bố là đúng hoặc những gì bạn đã tính toán là chính xác

senses.definition: a copy of printed material which is produced so that mistakes can be corrected

examples.x: She was checking the proofs of her latest novel.

senses.definition_vi: một bản sao của tài liệu in được tạo ra để có thể sửa lỗi

senses.definition: a standard used to measure the strength of alcoholic drinks
senses.definition_vi: một tiêu chuẩn được sử dụng để đo độ mạnh của đồ uống có cồn

senses.definition: to show by your actions or qualities that a particular fact is true

examples.x: These figures are living proof of the government's incompetence.
He is living proof that age is no barrier to new challenges.

senses.definition_vi: để chứng tỏ bằng hành động hoặc phẩm chất của bạn rằng một sự thật cụ thể là đúng

senses.definition: you can only judge if something is good or bad when you have tried it
senses.definition_vi: bạn chỉ có thể đánh giá xem điều gì đó tốt hay xấu khi bạn đã thử nó

senses.definition: ideas or statements that may be false or present only one side of an argument that are used in order to gain support for a political leader, party, etc.

examples.x: enemy propaganda
a propaganda campaign

senses.definition_vi: những ý tưởng hoặc tuyên bố có thể sai hoặc chỉ trình bày một mặt của lập luận được sử dụng để giành được sự ủng hộ cho một nhà lãnh đạo chính trị, đảng phái, v.v.

senses.definition: right, appropriate or correct; according to the rules

examples.x: We should have had a proper discussion before voting.
Please follow the proper procedures for dealing with complaints.
Manufacturers provide these directions to indicate the proper use of their products.
It is vital that they're given the proper training.
The Government is failing to deliver proper care and treatment to people with dementia.
Nothing is in its proper place.
He is never referred to by his proper name in the play.

senses.definition_vi: đúng, phù hợp hoặc chính xác; theo quy tắc

senses.definition: that you consider to be real and of a good enough standard

examples.x: I haven't had a proper meal in days.
Eat some proper food, not just toast and jam!
When are you going to get a proper job?

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn coi là thật và có đủ tiêu chuẩn tốt

senses.definition: socially and morally acceptable

examples.x: It is right and proper that parents take responsibility for their children's attendance at school.
The development was planned without proper regard to the interests of local people.
He is always perfectly proper in his behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận được về mặt xã hội và đạo đức

senses.definition: according to the most exact meaning of the word

examples.x: The celebrations proper always begin on the last stroke of midnight.

senses.definition_vi: theo ý nghĩa chính xác nhất của từ

senses.definition: complete

examples.x: We're in a proper mess now.

senses.definition_vi: đầy đủ

senses.definition: belonging to a particular type of thing; natural in a particular situation or place

examples.x: They should be treated with the dignity proper to all individuals created by God.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về một loại sự vật cụ thể; tự nhiên trong một tình huống hoặc địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: completely; to the greatest extent possible

examples.x: That's messed things up good and proper.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn; đến mức độ lớn nhất có thể

senses.definition: in a way that is correct and/or appropriate

examples.x: How much money do we need to do the job properly?
The television isn't working properly.
The baby was put on a ventilator to help her lungs function properly.
Make sure the letter is properly addressed.
Businesses should ensure that staff are properly trained in how to use new systems.
Paine believed that 'Liberty, properly understood, consists in the power of doing whatever does not injure another.'

senses.definition_vi: theo cách đúng và/hoặc phù hợp

senses.definition: in a way that is socially or morally acceptable

examples.x: You acted perfectly properly in approaching me first.
When will these kids learn to behave properly?

senses.definition_vi: theo cách chấp nhận được về mặt xã hội hoặc đạo đức

senses.definition: really; in fact

examples.x: He had usurped powers that properly belonged to parliament.
The subject is not, properly speaking (= really), a science.

senses.definition_vi: thực sự; trên thực tế

senses.definition: a thing or things that are owned by somebody; a possession or possessions

examples.x: personal/stolen property
This building is government property.
Be careful not to damage other people's property.

senses.definition_vi: một hoặc nhiều thứ thuộc sở hữu của ai đó; một hoặc nhiều vật sở hữu

senses.definition: land and buildings

examples.x: The price of property has risen enormously.
A sign indicates that it is now private property.
commercial/residential property
property prices/values/taxes
a property developer/owner
property development/investment
a slump in the property market
The storms caused millions of pounds worth of property damage.

senses.definition_vi: đất đai và nhà cửa

senses.definition: a building or buildings and the surrounding land

examples.x: to own/buy/purchase/acquire/sell a property
rental/investment properties
There are a lot of empty properties in the area.

senses.definition_vi: một hoặc nhiều tòa nhà và khu đất xung quanh

senses.definition: a quality or characteristic that something has

examples.x: Compare the physical properties of the two substances.
a plant with medicinal properties
The substance has properties similar to those of plastic.
The difference occurs because of local variation in soil properties.

senses.definition_vi: một phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm mà một cái gì đó có

senses.definition: a part or share of a whole

examples.x: Water covers a large proportion of the earth's surface.
Loam is a soil with roughly equal proportions of clay, sand and silt.
A significant proportion of the books have been translated from other languages.
A higher proportion of Americans go on to higher education than is the case in Britain.

senses.definition_vi: một phần hoặc cổ phần của một tổng thể

senses.definition: the relationship of one thing to another in size, amount, etc.

examples.x: The proportion of men to women in the college has changed dramatically over the years.
The basic ingredients are limestone and clay in the proportion 2:1.
The room is very long in proportion to (= relative to) its width.

senses.definition_vi: mối quan hệ của cái này với cái kia về kích thước, số lượng, v.v.

senses.definition: the correct relationship in size, degree, importance, etc. between one thing and another or between the parts of a whole

examples.x: You haven't drawn the figures in the foreground in proportion.
The head is out of proportion with the body.
an impressive building with fine proportions
There is an entrance hall of perfect proportions, twice as long as it is wide.
Always try to keep a sense of proportion (= of the relative importance of different things).

senses.definition_vi: mối quan hệ đúng đắn về kích thước, mức độ, tầm quan trọng, v.v. giữa cái này với cái kia hoặc giữa các phần của một tổng thể

senses.definition: the measurements of something; its size and shape

examples.x: This method divides the task into more manageable proportions.
a food shortage that could soon reach crisis proportions
a room of fairly generous proportions

senses.definition_vi: số đo của một cái gì đó; kích thước và hình dạng của nó

senses.definition: the equal relationship between two pairs of numbers, as in the statement ‘4 is to 8 as 6 is to 12’
senses.definition_vi: mối quan hệ bằng nhau giữa hai cặp số, như trong câu '4 chia cho 8 cũng như 6 chia cho 12'

senses.definition: to react to something in a sensible way and not think it is worse or more serious than it really is

examples.x: The problem of hooliganism should be kept in proportion. Only a small number of young people act in this way.

senses.definition_vi: để phản ứng với một điều gì đó một cách hợp lý và không coi nó tệ hơn hoặc nghiêm trọng hơn thực tế

senses.definition: larger, more serious, etc. in relation to something than is necessary or appropriate

examples.x: They earn salaries out of all proportion to their ability.
The media have blown the incident up out of all proportion.

senses.definition_vi: lớn hơn, nghiêm trọng hơn, v.v. so với cái gì đó hơn là cần thiết hoặc phù hợp

senses.definition: a formal suggestion or plan; the act of making a suggestion

examples.x: to submit/present/put forward a proposal
to consider/discuss a proposal
to accept/approve/support/reject a proposal
a proposal to build more office accommodation
His proposal that the system should be changed was rejected.
The proposal for a new high-speed railway met with strong opposition.
When will the minister publish his proposals on reform of the health service?
two recent proposals by Vancouver City Council
Reaction to the proposals from technology companies has so far been muted.
Under these proposals, the Commission will be significantly strengthened.
The Republicans in Congress will vote for the president's budget proposal.

senses.definition_vi: một đề xuất hoặc kế hoạch chính thức; hành động đưa ra một đề xuất

senses.definition: an act of formally asking somebody to marry you

examples.x: She accepted his proposal of marriage.
a marriage proposal

senses.definition_vi: hành động chính thức cầu hôn ai đó

senses.definition: to suggest a plan, an idea, etc. for people to think about and decide on

examples.x: The government proposed changes to the voting system.
The Board of Directors is proposing an amendment to Article I.
The three countries had proposed a plan for him to hand over power to a chosen successor.
What would you propose?
Other services will not be affected by the proposed legislation.
It is one of several proposed hospital developments around town.
Since the idea was first proposed, no action has been taken.
a proposed reform/rule/law/project
This year we propose a tax increase of 3.9 percent.
She proposed that the book be banned.
She proposed that the book should be banned.
It was proposed that the president be elected for a period of two years.
He proposed changing the name of the company.

examples.cf: it is proposed to do something
examples.x: It was proposed to pay the money from public funds.

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất một kế hoạch, một ý tưởng, v.v. để mọi người xem xét và quyết định

senses.definition: to intend to do something

examples.x: What do you propose to do now?
How do you propose getting home?
We do not propose to take any further action in the matter.

senses.definition_vi: có ý định làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to ask somebody to marry you

examples.x: He was afraid that if he proposed she might refuse.
She proposed to me!
to propose marriage

senses.definition_vi: cầu hôn ai đó

senses.definition: to suggest something at a formal meeting and ask people to vote on it

examples.x: I propose Tom Ellis for chairman.
He was proposed for the job of treasurer.
to propose a motion (= to be the main speaker in support of an idea at a formal debate)

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất điều gì đó tại một cuộc họp chính thức và yêu cầu mọi người bỏ phiếu về nó

senses.definition: to suggest an explanation of something for people to consider

examples.x: She proposed a possible solution to the mystery.

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất một lời giải thích về điều gì đó để mọi người xem xét

senses.definition: to ask people to wish somebody health, happiness and success by raising their glasses and drinking

examples.x: I'd like to propose a toast to the bride and groom.

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu mọi người chúc ai đó sức khỏe, hạnh phúc và thành công bằng cách nâng cốc và uống

senses.definition: an idea or a plan of action that is suggested, especially in business

examples.x: I'd like to put a business proposition to you.
He was trying to make it look like an attractive proposition.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc kế hoạch hành động được đề xuất, đặc biệt là trong kinh doanh

senses.definition: a thing that you intend to do; a problem, task or person to be dealt with

examples.x: Getting a work permit in the UK is not always a simple proposition.

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn dự định làm; một vấn đề, nhiệm vụ hoặc người cần giải quyết

senses.definition: (in the US) a suggested change to the law that people can vote on

examples.x: How did you vote on Proposition 8?

senses.definition_vi: (ở Mỹ) một đề xuất thay đổi luật mà mọi người có thể bỏ phiếu

senses.definition: a statement that expresses an opinion

examples.x: Her assessment is based on the proposition that power corrupts.
The book puts forward a number of extreme propositions about the nature of language.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố bày tỏ một ý kiến

senses.definition: a statement of a theorem, and an explanation of how it can be proved

examples.x: First of all we need to examine whether this proposition is true.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố về một định lý và giải thích cách chứng minh nó

senses.definition: to officially charge somebody with a crime in court

examples.x: The police decided not to prosecute.
Trespassers will be prosecuted (= a notice telling people to keep out of a particular area).
The company was prosecuted for breaching the Health and Safety Act.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức buộc tội ai đó phạm tội trước tòa

senses.definition: to be a lawyer in a court case for a person or an organization that is charging somebody with a crime

examples.x: the prosecuting counsel/lawyer/attorney
James Spencer, prosecuting, claimed that the witness was lying.

senses.definition_vi: là luật sư trong một vụ kiện cho một người hoặc tổ chức đang buộc tội ai đó phạm tội

senses.definition: to continue taking part in or doing something

examples.x: They had overwhelming public support to prosecute the war.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục tham gia hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the process of trying to prove in court that somebody is guilty of a crime (= of prosecuting them); the process of being officially charged with a crime in court

examples.x: Prosecution for a first minor offence rarely leads to imprisonment.
He threatened to bring a private prosecution against the doctor.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cố gắng chứng minh trước tòa rằng ai đó có tội; quá trình bị buộc tội chính thức phạm tội trước tòa

senses.definition: a person or an organization that prosecutes somebody in court, together with the lawyers, etc.

examples.x: He was a witness for the prosecution.
The prosecution has/have failed to prove its/their case.
defence and prosecution
a prosecution lawyer

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc tổ chức truy tố ai đó trước tòa, cùng với các luật sư, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of making something happen or continue
senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc tiếp tục

senses.definition: a public official who charges somebody officially with a crime and prosecutes them in court

examples.x: the public/state prosecutor

senses.definition_vi: một công chức buộc tội chính thức ai đó phạm tội và truy tố họ trước tòa

senses.definition: a lawyer who leads the case against a defendant in court

examples.x: The prosecutor rose to give the opening address.

senses.definition_vi: một luật sư dẫn dắt vụ án chống lại bị cáo tại tòa

senses.definition: the possibility that something will happen

examples.x: There is no immediate prospect of peace.
They faced the prospect of defeat in the elections.
There was insufficient evidence for a realistic prospect of conviction.
It's a move that raises the prospect of a takeover battle for the airline.
Her family is having to come to terms with the increasingly unlikely prospect of ever finding her.
There's a reasonable prospect that his debts will be paid.
A place in the semi-finals is in prospect (= likely to happen).

senses.definition_vi: khả năng điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: an idea of what might or will happen in the future

examples.x: an exciting prospect
Travelling alone around the world is a daunting prospect.
Her heart sank at the prospect of marriage to a man she loathed.
The prospect of becoming a father filled him with alarm.
I don't relish the prospect of having to share an office.
I'm very excited at the prospect of joining the team.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng về những gì có thể hoặc sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai

senses.definition: the chances of being successful

examples.x: good job/employment/career prospects
industries with excellent growth prospects
At 25 he was an unemployed musician with no prospects.
Long-term prospects for the economy have improved.
The war undermines future prospects for economic growth.
Their prospects of success are slight.
What are the prospects of promotion in this job?
We are highly optimistic about the future prospects of the company.

senses.definition_vi: cơ hội thành công

senses.definition: a person who is likely to be successful in a competition or in a particular career

examples.x: She is one of Canada's best prospects for a gold medal.
a list of the hot new prospects on the literary scene

senses.definition_vi: một người có khả năng thành công trong một cuộc thi hoặc trong một sự nghiệp cụ thể

senses.definition: a wide view of an area of land, etc.

examples.x: a delightful prospect of the lake

senses.definition_vi: một cái nhìn rộng về một khu vực đất đai, v.v.

senses.definition: expected to do something or to become something

examples.x: a prospective buyer
I had a phone call from a prospective client today.

senses.definition_vi: được kỳ vọng sẽ làm điều gì đó hoặc trở thành điều gì đó

senses.definition: expected to happen soon

examples.x: They are worried about prospective changes in the law.
On learning of a prospective sale, the lawyer should call the client as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: dự kiến sẽ sớm xảy ra

senses.definition: the state of being successful, especially in making money

examples.x: Our future prosperity depends on economic growth.
The country is enjoying a period of peace and prosperity.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái thành công, đặc biệt là trong việc kiếm tiền

senses.definition: to make sure that somebody/something is not harmed, injured, damaged, etc.

examples.x: to protect children/citizens/civilians/consumers/workers
Our aim is to protect the jobs of our members.
the section of the treaty that protects the rights of employees
Each company is fighting to protect its own commercial interests.
A majority of Democrats believe that such regulations protect the public.
Troops have been sent to protect aid workers against attack.
They huddled together to protect themselves from the wind.
a paint that helps protect against rust
Vitamin B12 may have a role in protecting from heart disease.

senses.definition_vi: đảm bảo rằng ai đó/điều gì đó không bị tổn hại, bị thương, bị hư hại, v.v.

senses.definition: to introduce laws that make it illegal to kill, harm or damage a particular animal, area of land, building, etc.

examples.x: a protected area/species
the need to protect the environment
Polar bears have been protected by law in Norway since 1973.
The plant is protected under the Wildlife and Countryside Act.

senses.definition_vi: ban hành luật cấm giết, làm hại hoặc phá hủy một loài động vật, khu vực đất đai, tòa nhà, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: to help an industry in your own country by taxing goods from other countries so that there is less competition

examples.x: protected markets

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ một ngành công nghiệp trong nước bằng cách đánh thuế hàng hóa từ các quốc gia khác để giảm cạnh tranh

senses.definition: to provide somebody/something with insurance against fire, injury, damage, etc.

examples.x: Many policies do not protect you against personal injury.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/điều gì đó bảo hiểm chống cháy, thương tích, thiệt hại, v.v.

senses.definition: to limit access to data, a web page, etc., for example by using passwords or encryption (= special codes)

examples.x: Security products are designed to protect information from unauthorized access.
All these pages are password-protected.

senses.definition_vi: hạn chế quyền truy cập vào dữ liệu, trang web, v.v., ví dụ bằng cách sử dụng mật khẩu hoặc mã hóa (mã đặc biệt)

senses.definition: the act of protecting somebody/something; the state of being protected

examples.x: Wear clothes that provide adequate protection against the wind and rain.
His straw hat offered some protection from the sun.
We seek to ensure the protection of human rights.
the conservation and protection of the environment
They are campaigning for better protection for workers.
She carries a gun in her bag for personal protection.
He asked to be put under police protection.
These people remain under the protection of the United Nations.
data protection laws
the importance of environmental protection

senses.definition_vi: hành động bảo vệ ai đó/điều gì đó; trạng thái được bảo vệ

senses.definition: a thing that protects somebody/something against something

examples.x: The plastic sheeting is not a complete protection against the rain.
The trench served as a protection from enemy gunfire.
He wears a helmet as protection.
Fill the cooling system with antifreeze as a protection against frost.
They wore the charm as a protection against evil spirits.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ bảo vệ ai đó/điều gì đó khỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition: insurance against fire, injury, damage, etc.

examples.x: Our policy offers complete protection against fire and theft.

senses.definition_vi: bảo hiểm chống cháy, thương tích, thiệt hại, v.v.

senses.definition: the system of helping an industry in your own country by taxing foreign goods

examples.x: The government is ready to introduce protection for the car industry.

senses.definition_vi: hệ thống giúp đỡ một ngành công nghiệp trong nước bằng cách đánh thuế hàng hóa nước ngoài

senses.definition: the system of paying criminals so that they will not attack your business or property

examples.x: to pay protection money
to run a protection racket

senses.definition_vi: hệ thống trả tiền cho tội phạm để chúng không tấn công doanh nghiệp hoặc tài sản của bạn

senses.definition: providing or intended to provide protection

examples.x: Workers should wear full protective clothing.
a protective layer of varnish
The ozone layer forms a protective barrier against the sun's rays.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp hoặc dự định cung cấp sự bảo vệ

senses.definition: having or showing a wish to protect somebody/something

examples.x: He put a protective arm around her shoulders.
She had been fiercely protective towards him as a teenager.
He was extremely protective of his role as advisor.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc thể hiện mong muốn bảo vệ ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: intended to give an advantage to your own country’s industry

examples.x: protective tariffs

senses.definition_vi: nhằm mục đích mang lại lợi thế cho ngành công nghiệp của chính quốc gia mình

senses.definition: a substance, found within all living things, that forms the structure of muscles, organs, etc. There are many different proteins and they are an essential part of what humans and animals eat to help them grow and stay healthy.

examples.x: essential proteins and vitamins
protein deficiency
Peas, beans and lentils are a good source of vegetable protein.
Gluten is a protein found in wheat and other grains.

senses.definition_vi: một chất, có trong tất cả các sinh vật, tạo nên cấu trúc của cơ, nội tạng, v.v. Có nhiều loại protein khác nhau và chúng là một phần thiết yếu của những gì con người và động vật ăn để giúp chúng phát triển và khỏe mạnh.

senses.definition: the expression of strong dislike of or opposition to something; a statement or an action that shows this

examples.x: to hold/organize/join a protest
violent/anti-war protests
The riot began as a peaceful protest.
mass/street protests
a protest march/movement
Unions have called for a day of protest on 24 February.
The announcement raised a storm of protest.
There have been mounting protests at the treatment of asylum seekers by the government.
The director resigned in protest at the decision.
People rioted in the streets in protest.
protests over plans to close the museum
She accepted the charge without protest.
The workers staged a protest against the proposed changes in their contracts.
They have decided not to attend the Bonn conference as a protest.
The strike began the day before as a protest against the proposed cuts.
The building work will go ahead, despite protests from local residents.
The country has undergone two weeks of protests by workers and students.

senses.definition_vi: sự bày tỏ sự không thích mạnh mẽ hoặc sự phản đối đối với điều gì đó; một tuyên bố hoặc một hành động thể hiện điều này

senses.definition: unwillingly and after expressing disagreement

examples.x: She wrote a letter of apology but only under protest.
The strikers returned to work, but under protest.

senses.definition_vi: một cách miễn cưỡng và sau khi bày tỏ sự bất đồng

senses.definition: to say or do something to show that you disagree with something or think it is bad, especially publicly

examples.x: There's no use protesting, I won't change my mind.
They were taken away protesting loudly.
Students took to the streets to protest against the decision.
The victim's widow protested at the leniency of the sentence.
Tenants have been protesting about conditions in their block of flats.
They fully intend to protest the decision.
In college she protested the war in Vietnam.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó để thể hiện rằng bạn không đồng ý với điều gì đó hoặc cho rằng điều đó là xấu, đặc biệt là công khai

senses.definition: to state clearly that something is true, especially when you have been accused of something or when other people do not believe you

examples.x: She has always protested her innocence.
He protested that the journey was too far by car.
She protested that she could not receive a fair trial.
‘That's not what you said earlier!’ Jane protested.

senses.definition_vi: nói rõ ràng rằng điều gì đó là đúng, đặc biệt là khi bạn bị buộc tội về điều gì đó hoặc khi những người khác không tin bạn

senses.definition: a person who makes a public protest

examples.x: Thousands of protesters marched through the city.

senses.definition_vi: một người thực hiện một cuộc biểu tình công khai

senses.definition: a system of fixed rules and formal behaviour used at official meetings, usually between governments

examples.x: a breach of protocol
the protocol of diplomatic visits

senses.definition_vi: một hệ thống các quy tắc cố định và hành vi trang trọng được sử dụng tại các cuộc họp chính thức, thường là giữa các chính phủ

senses.definition: the first or original version of an agreement, especially a treaty between countries, etc.; an extra part added to an agreement or treaty

examples.x: the first Geneva Protocol
It is set out in a legally binding protocol which forms part of the treaty.
The dates were agreed under a protocol to the climate convention.

senses.definition_vi: bản đầu tiên hoặc bản gốc của một thỏa thuận, đặc biệt là một hiệp ước giữa các quốc gia, v.v.; một phần bổ sung được thêm vào một thỏa thuận hoặc hiệp ước

senses.definition: a set of rules that control the way data is sent between computers
senses.definition_vi: một tập hợp các quy tắc kiểm soát cách dữ liệu được gửi giữa các máy tính

senses.definition: a plan for performing a scientific experiment or medical treatment
senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch để thực hiện một thí nghiệm khoa học hoặc một phương pháp điều trị y tế

senses.definition: feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done, or are connected with

examples.x: proud parents
the proud owner of a new car
The girls have made me extremely proud.
Your achievements are something to be proud of.
Barry was proud of the fact that he had never missed a day's work in his life.

examples.cf: proud of somebody/something/yourself for doing something
examples.x: He was proud of himself for not giving up.
I feel very proud to be a part of the team.
I'm proud to say you're my son.
We are proud to present this award to you.
She was proud that her daughter had so much talent.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hài lòng và mãn nguyện về điều gì đó bạn sở hữu hoặc đã làm, hoặc có liên quan đến

senses.definition: causing somebody to feel proud

examples.x: This is the proudest moment of my life.
It was a proud day in the nation’s history
The car had been his proudest possession.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó cảm thấy tự hào

senses.definition: feeling that you are better and more important than other people

examples.x: She comes across as proud and arrogant.
He was too proud now to be seen with his former friends.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy mình tốt hơn và quan trọng hơn những người khác

senses.definition: having respect for yourself and not wanting to lose the respect of others

examples.x: They were a proud and independent people.
Don't be too proud to ask for help.
What has become of this once proud nation?

senses.definition_vi: có sự tôn trọng bản thân và không muốn mất đi sự tôn trọng của người khác

senses.definition: beautiful, tall and impressive

examples.x: The sunflowers stretched tall and proud to the sun.

senses.definition_vi: đẹp, cao lớn và ấn tượng

senses.definition: very proud/pleased

examples.x: Now he's passed his driving test, he's as proud as Punch.

senses.definition_vi: rất tự hào/hài lòng

examples.x: They hope this new evidence will prove her innocence.
‘I know you're lying.’ ‘Prove it!’
He felt he needed to prove his point (= show other people that he was right).
Are you just doing this to prove a point?
What are you trying to prove?

The prosecution has failed to prove its case.
She continued to prove her worth to the team.
Just give me a chance and I'll prove it to you.
This proves (that) I was right.
She was determined to prove everyone wrong.
In this country, you are innocent until proven guilty.
You've just proved yourself to be a liar.
This just proves what I have been saying for some time.
Can it be proved that he did commit these offences?

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng các sự kiện, bằng chứng, v.v. để chứng tỏ điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: if something proves dangerous, expensive, etc. or if it proves to be dangerous, etc., you discover that it is dangerous, etc. over a period of time

examples.x: The strategy has proved successful.

Their fears proved to be groundless.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó hóa ra nguy hiểm, tốn kém, v.v. hoặc nếu nó hóa ra là nguy hiểm, v.v., bạn sẽ phát hiện ra rằng nó nguy hiểm, v.v. trong một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: to show other people how good you are at doing something or that you are capable of doing something

examples.x: He constantly feels he has to prove himself to others.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện cho người khác thấy bạn giỏi làm điều gì đó như thế nào hoặc bạn có khả năng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện cho người khác thấy bạn là một kiểu người nhất định hoặc bạn có một phẩm chất nhất định

examples.x: While the dough is proving, crumble the feta and chop the olives.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó một thứ gì đó mà họ cần hoặc muốn; hoặc làm cho nó có sẵn cho họ sử dụng

senses.definition: to state that something will or must happen

examples.x: The final section provides that any work produced for the company is thereafter owned by the company.

senses.definition_vi: nêu rõ rằng điều gì đó sẽ hoặc phải xảy ra

examples.x: the provinces of Canada

senses.definition_vi: một trong những khu vực mà một số quốc gia được chia thành với chính quyền địa phương riêng

senses.definition: all the parts of a country except the capital city

examples.x: The show will tour the provinces after it closes in London.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả các vùng của một quốc gia ngoại trừ thủ đô

examples.x: Such decisions are normally the province of higher management.

senses.definition_vi: lĩnh vực kiến thức, sở thích hoặc trách nhiệm cụ thể của một người

senses.definition: connected with one of the large areas that some countries are divided into, with its own local government

examples.x: provincial assemblies/elections

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến một trong những khu vực lớn mà một số quốc gia được chia thành, với chính quyền địa phương riêng

senses.definition: connected with the parts of a country that do not include the capital city, especially when these are regarded as lacking culture or modern ideas

examples.x: a provincial town

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các vùng của một quốc gia không bao gồm thủ đô, đặc biệt là khi chúng bị coi là thiếu văn hóa hoặc ý tưởng hiện đại

senses.definition: unwilling to consider new or different ideas or things

examples.x: In spite of his education and travels, he has remained very provincial.

senses.definition_vi: không sẵn lòng xem xét những ý tưởng hoặc điều mới hoặc khác biệt

examples.x: housing provision

There is no provision for anyone to sit down here.
The provision of specialist teachers is being increased.
Several companies are responsible for the provision of cleaning services.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cung cấp cho ai đó thứ họ cần hoặc muốn; thứ gì đó được cung cấp

senses.definition: preparations that you make for something that might or will happen in the future

examples.x: He had already made provisions for (= planned for the financial future of) his wife and children before the accident.
You should make provision for things going wrong.
Small businesses are advised to make adequate provisions against bad debts.
The plans for developing the area include provision for both water and field sports.

senses.definition_vi: những sự chuẩn bị bạn thực hiện cho điều gì đó có thể hoặc sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai

senses.definition: supplies of food and drink, especially for a long journey

examples.x: We have enough provisions to last us two weeks.
We went into town to stock up on provisions.

senses.definition_vi: hàng tiếp tế thực phẩm và đồ uống, đặc biệt là cho một chuyến đi dài

senses.definition: a condition or an arrangement in a legal document

examples.x: The same provisions apply to foreign-owned companies.
Under the provisions of the lease, the tenant is responsible for repairs.

senses.definition_vi: một điều kiện hoặc một thỏa thuận trong một văn bản pháp lý

senses.definition: to cause a particular reaction or have a particular effect

examples.x: The announcement provoked a storm of protest.
The article was intended to provoke discussion.
Dairy products may provoke allergic reactions in some people.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra một phản ứng cụ thể hoặc có một tác động cụ thể

examples.x: Be careful what you say—he's easily provoked.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó mà bạn biết sẽ làm phiền ai đó để họ phản ứng một cách tức giận

senses.definition: relating to psychiatry or to mental illnesses

examples.x: psychiatric disorders
a psychiatric hospital/nurse/patient
psychiatric treatment

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến tâm thần học hoặc các bệnh tâm thần

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến tâm trí con người và cách nó hoạt động

senses.definition: connected with the study of psychology

examples.x: psychological research

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến việc nghiên cứu tâm lý học

senses.definition: a scientist who studies and is trained in psychology

examples.x: to see a psychologist
to go to a psychologist
an educational psychologist
a clinical psychologist (= one who treats people with a mental illness)

a child psychologist
a sports psychologist

senses.definition_vi: một nhà khoa học nghiên cứu và được đào tạo về tâm lý học

senses.definition: the scientific study of the mind and how it influences behaviour

examples.x: clinical/educational/child/sport psychology
Kevin has a master's degree in psychology.

senses.definition_vi: nghiên cứu khoa học về tâm trí và cách nó ảnh hưởng đến hành vi

senses.definition: the kind of mind that somebody has that makes them think or behave in a particular way

examples.x: the psychology of small boys
I help the actors understand the psychology of their characters.
The answers we give will reflect our own psychology.

senses.definition_vi: loại tâm trí mà ai đó có khiến họ suy nghĩ hoặc hành động theo một cách nhất định

senses.definition: how the mind influences behaviour in a particular area of life

examples.x: the psychology of interpersonal relationships

senses.definition_vi: cách tâm trí ảnh hưởng đến hành vi trong một lĩnh vực cụ thể của cuộc sống

examples.x: We're all going to the pub after work.

They spent the whole evening in the pub.
He is one of the regulars at the pub.
I got home from the pub just after 11.

the landlord of the local pub
The Elm Tree will remain a traditional village pub.

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà nơi mọi người đến để uống rượu và gặp gỡ bạn bè. Quán rượu phục vụ đồ uống có cồn và các loại đồ uống khác, và thường cả đồ ăn.

senses.definition: connected with ordinary people in society in general

examples.x: The campaign is designed to increase public awareness of the issues.
Levels of waste from the factory may be a danger to public health.
Public safety must come first.
Why would the closure of hospitals be in the public interest (= useful to ordinary people)?
The government had to bow to public pressure.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến người dân bình thường trong xã hội nói chung

senses.definition: provided, especially by the government, for the use of people in general

examples.x: a public education system

senses.definition: to affect something so that it reaches a particular level or state

examples.x: This development could push the country into recession.
The rise in interest rates will push prices up.
Little pent-up demand exists to push the economy forward this year.
The surplus has helped push world prices to as little as 55 euros per tonne.
Such a huge population increase will continue to push food prices higher.
Rising inflation pushes down real interest rates.

senses.definition_vi: tác động đến một cái gì đó để nó đạt đến một mức độ hoặc trạng thái nhất định

senses.definition: to persuade or encourage somebody to do something that they may not want to do

examples.x: He made it clear that he would resist any attempt to push him into early retirement.
My teacher pushed me into entering the competition.
No one pushed you to take the job, did they?

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục hoặc khuyến khích ai đó làm điều gì đó mà họ có thể không muốn làm

senses.definition: to make somebody work hard

examples.x: The music teacher really pushes her pupils.
Lucy should push herself a little harder.
He keeps pushing himself to get better.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó làm việc chăm chỉ

senses.definition: to put pressure on somebody and make them angry or upset

examples.x: Her parents are very tolerant, but sometimes she pushes them too far.
He felt he was being pushed to the limit of his self-control.

senses.definition_vi: gây áp lực lên ai đó và làm họ tức giận hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: to try hard to persuade people to accept or agree with a new idea, buy a new product, etc.

examples.x: The interview gave him a chance to push his latest movie.
She didn't want to push the point any further at that moment.
He continues to push his own political agenda.
Sales promotion is designed to push certain products.
The two governments are pushing for economic reform in the region.
They're pushing hard for a ban on GM foods.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng thuyết phục mọi người chấp nhận hoặc đồng ý với một ý tưởng mới, mua một sản phẩm mới, v.v.

senses.definition: to sell illegal drugs
senses.definition_vi: bán ma túy bất hợp pháp

senses.definition: to move forward quickly through an area

examples.x: The army pushed (on) towards the capital.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển nhanh chóng qua một khu vực

senses.definition: to be nearly 40, 50, etc. years old
senses.definition_vi: gần 40, 50, v.v. tuổi

senses.definition: to be dead and buried in the ground
senses.definition_vi: đã chết và được chôn cất dưới đất

senses.definition: to react in a sudden or extreme way to something unexpected that has frightened you

examples.x: The prime minister pressed the panic button yesterday as Britain’s economy plunged deeper into crisis.

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng đột ngột hoặc cực đoan với điều gì đó bất ngờ khiến bạn sợ hãi

senses.definition: to do exactly the right things to please somebody

examples.x: a new satirical comedy show that pushes all the right buttons

senses.definition_vi: làm chính xác những điều đúng đắn để làm hài lòng ai đó

senses.definition: to spend a lot of money on enjoying yourself or celebrating something
senses.definition_vi: chi nhiều tiền để tận hưởng bản thân hoặc ăn mừng điều gì đó

senses.definition: to attempt to go beyond what is allowed or thought to be possible

examples.x: We aim to push the boundaries of what we can achieve.
She pushes her physical limits through various endurance challenges.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng vượt qua những gì được phép hoặc được cho là có thể

senses.definition: to go beyond the limits of what is allowed or thought to be possible

examples.x: He is a performer who consistently pushes the envelope of TV comedy.

senses.definition_vi: vượt qua giới hạn của những gì được phép hoặc được cho là có thể

senses.definition: to take a risk because you have successfully avoided problems in the past

examples.x: You didn't get caught last time, but don't push your luck!

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận rủi ro vì bạn đã tránh được vấn đề trong quá khứ

senses.definition: to force somebody to lose control of their behaviour, usually after a particular event or series of events

examples.x: No one knows exactly what caused his breakdown, but losing his job may have pushed him over the edge.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó mất kiểm soát hành vi của họ, thường sau một sự kiện hoặc một loạt các sự kiện cụ thể

senses.definition: to react in a sudden or extreme way to something unexpected that has frightened you

examples.x: The prime minister pushed the panic button yesterday as Britain's economy plunged deeper into crisis.

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng đột ngột hoặc cực đoan với điều gì đó bất ngờ khiến bạn sợ hãi

senses.definition: to try to forget about something unpleasant

examples.x: I tried to push the thought to the back of my mind.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng quên đi điều gì đó khó chịu

senses.definition: to move something into a particular place or position

examples.x: Put the cases down there, please.
Did you put sugar in my coffee?
Put your hand up if you need more paper.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó vào một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to move something into a particular place or position using force

examples.x: He put his fist through a glass door.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó vào một địa điểm hoặc vị trí cụ thể bằng lực

senses.definition: to cause somebody/something to go to a particular place

examples.x: Her family put her into a nursing home.
It was the year the Americans put a man on the moon.

senses.definition_vi: khiến ai đó/cái gì đó đến một địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to attach or fix something to something else

examples.x: We had to put new locks on all the doors.

senses.definition_vi: gắn hoặc cố định một cái gì đó vào một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: to write something or make a mark on something

examples.x: Put your name here.
Friday at 11? I'll put it in my diary.
I couldn't read what she had put.

senses.definition_vi: viết một cái gì đó hoặc tạo một dấu trên một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to bring somebody/something into the state or condition mentioned

examples.x: I was put in charge of the office.
The incident put her in a bad mood.
Put yourself in my position. What would you have done?
I tried to put the matter into perspective.
Don't go putting yourself at risk.
I am determined to put things right.
It was time to put their suggestion into practice.
This new injury will put him out of action for several weeks.
He put Ray on guard with a gun.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ai đó/cái gì đó vào trạng thái hoặc tình trạng được đề cập

senses.definition: to make somebody/something feel something or be affected by something

examples.x: Her new job has put a great strain on her.
They put pressure on her to resign.
It's time you put a stop to this childish behaviour.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó cảm thấy điều gì đó hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to express or state something in a particular way

examples.x: She put it very tactfully.
Put simply, we accept their offer or go bankrupt.
Simply put, the film is a masterpiece.
I was, to put it mildly, annoyed (= I was extremely angry).
Putting it bluntly, the project was a disaster.
He was too trusting—or, to put it another way, he had no head for business.
The meat was—how shall I put it?—a little overdone.
As T.S. Eliot puts it…
She had never tried to put this feeling into words.
Can you help me put this letter into good English, please?
I thought you put your points very well.

senses.definition_vi: biểu đạt hoặc nêu một cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to give or attach a particular level of importance, trust, value, etc. to something

examples.x: Our company puts the emphasis on quality.
He put a limit on the amount we could spend.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một mức độ quan trọng, tin cậy, giá trị, v.v. cụ thể cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to consider somebody/something to belong to the class or level mentioned

examples.x: I'd put her in the top rank of modern novelists.

senses.definition_vi: coi ai đó/cái gì đó thuộc về lớp hoặc cấp độ được đề cập

senses.definition_vi: ném tạ

senses.definition: used to say that you think somebody is capable of doing something wrong, illegal, etc.
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ ai đó có khả năng làm điều gì đó sai trái, bất hợp pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: to have many sexual partners
senses.definition_vi: có nhiều bạn tình

senses.definition: to suggest something to somebody to see if they can argue against it

examples.x: I put it to you that you are the only person who had a motive for the crime.

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất một cái gì đó cho ai đó để xem liệu họ có thể phản bác lại nó không

senses.definition: to persuade somebody to believe something that is not true

examples.x: Don't try to put one over on me!

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó tin vào điều gì đó không đúng sự thật

senses.definition: to force somebody to experience something difficult or unpleasant

examples.x: They really put me through it (= asked me difficult questions) at the interview.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó trải qua điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: used when comparing or contrasting somebody/something with a group of other people or things to mean ‘combined’ or ‘in total’

examples.x: Your department spent more last year than all the others put together.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi so sánh hoặc đối chiếu ai đó/cái gì đó với một nhóm người hoặc vật khác để có nghĩa là 'kết hợp' hoặc 'tổng cộng'

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to stop just talking about something and actually do it, show it, etc.
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó ngừng chỉ nói về điều gì đó và thực sự làm, thể hiện, v.v.

senses.definition: a game, etc. that you have to think about carefully in order to answer it or do it

examples.x: a crossword puzzle
a book of puzzles for children

senses.definition_vi: một trò chơi, v.v. mà bạn phải suy nghĩ cẩn thận để trả lời hoặc thực hiện nó

senses.definition: something that is difficult to understand or explain

examples.x: The deeper meaning of the poem remains a puzzle.
The detectives were beginning to solve the murder. All the pieces of the puzzle were falling neatly into place.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó khó hiểu hoặc giải thích

senses.definition: a picture printed on cardboard (= very thick, stiff card) or wood, that has been cut up into a lot of small pieces of different shapes that you have to fit together again
senses.definition_vi: một bức tranh được in trên bìa cứng (= giấy dày, cứng) hoặc gỗ, đã được cắt thành nhiều mảnh nhỏ có hình dạng khác nhau mà bạn phải ghép lại với nhau

senses.definition: making people think seriously about a particular subject or issue

examples.x: a brilliant and thought-provoking play

senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người suy nghĩ nghiêm túc về một chủ đề hoặc vấn đề cụ thể
